verses.sanskrit:
<vt>अथ प्रथमोऽध्यायः</vt>
ईश्वरानुग्रहादेव पुंसामद्वैतवासना ।
महद्भयपरित्राणाद्विप्राणामुपजायते ॥ १-१॥
verses.roman:
<vt>Chapter 1</vt>
īśvarānugrahādeva puṃsāmadvaitavāsanā .
mahadbhayaparitrāṇādviprāṇāmupajāyate ..1-1..
verses.colloquial:
<vt>Chapter 1</vt>
iishvara anugrahaat eva pumsaam advaita vaasanaa |
mahat bhaya paritraanaat vipraanaam upajaayate ..1-1..
verses.translation_reworded: Only by God's grace do the wise come to long for the realization of non-dual Brahman, and through that longing they are released from great fear.

verses.sanskrit:
येनेदं पूरितं सर्वमात्मनैवात्मनात्मनि ।
निराकारं कथं वन्दे ह्यभिन्नं शिवमव्ययम् ॥ १-२॥
verses.roman:
yenedaṃ pūritaṃ sarvamātmanaivātmanātmani .
nirākāraṃ kathaṃ vande hyabhinnaṃ śivamavyayam ..1-2..
verses.colloquial:
yena idam pooritam sarvam aatmana eva aatmana aatmani |
niraakaaram katham vande hi abhinnam shivam avyayam ..1-2..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly, the whole universe is pervaded by the Atman. And since the Atman is veiled only by Itself, how could I offer worship to that formless, undivided, changeless Supreme Bliss?

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्चभूतात्मकं विश्वं मरीचिजलसन्निभम् ।
कस्याप्यहो नमस्कुर्यामहमेको निरञ्जनः ॥ १-३॥
verses.roman:
pañcabhūtātmakaṃ viśvaṃ marīcijalasannibham .
kasyāpyaho namaskuryāmahameko nirañjanaḥ ..1-3..
verses.colloquial:
panchabhuutaatmakam vishvam mariichijalasannibham |
kasya api aho namaskuryaam aham ekah niranjanah ..1-3..
verses.translation_reworded: This universe, made of the five elements (space, air, fire, water, and earth), is like the water of a mirage. Being myself that one stainless Atman, to whom could I bow?

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मैव केवलं सर्वं भेदाभेदो न विद्यते ।
अस्ति नास्ति कथं ब्रूयां विस्मयः प्रतिभाति मे ॥ १-४॥
verses.roman:
ātmaiva kevalaṃ sarvaṃ bhedābhedo na vidyate .
asti nāsti kathaṃ brūyāṃ vismayaḥ pratibhāti me ..1-4..
verses.colloquial:
aatmaiva kevalam sarvam bhedaabhedo na vidyate |
asti naasti katham brooyaam vismayah pratibhaati me ..1-4..
verses.translation_reworded: In truth the Atman alone is everything, and within It there is neither division nor absence of division. To me it seems baffling to say either "the Atman exists" or "the Atman does not exist."

verses.sanskrit:
वेदान्तसारसर्वस्वं ज्ञानं विज्ञानमेव च ।
अहमात्मा निराकारः सर्वव्यापी स्वभावतः ॥ १-५॥
verses.roman:
vedāntasārasarvasvaṃ jñānaṃ vijñānameva ca .
ahamātmā nirākāraḥ sarvavyāpī svabhāvataḥ ..1-5..
verses.colloquial:
vedaanta saara sarvasvam jnaanam vijnaanam eva cha |
aham aatmaa niraakaarah sarva vyaapii svabhaavatah ..1-5..
verses.translation_reworded: The heart of all Vedanta is the knowledge and direct realization of the Atman. By my very nature I am that formless Atman that pervades everything.

verses.sanskrit:
यो वै सर्वात्मको देवो निष्कलो गगनोपमः ।
स्वभावनिर्मलः शुद्धः स एवायं न संशयः ॥ १-६॥
verses.roman:
yo vai sarvātmako devo niṣkalo gaganopamaḥ .
svabhāvanirmalaḥ śuddhaḥ sa evāyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..1-6..
verses.colloquial:
yo vai sarva aatmako devo nishkalo gagana upamah |
svabhaava nirmalah shuddhah sa eva ayam na samshayah ..1-6..
verses.translation_reworded: Without any doubt I am that Atman: present everywhere, self-luminous, undivided like space, pure in Its own nature, and never dimmed by maya.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमेवाव्ययोऽनन्तः शुद्धविज्ञानविग्रहः ।
सुखं दुःखं न जानामि कथं कस्यापि वर्तते ॥ १-७॥
verses.roman:
ahamevāvyayo'nantaḥ śuddhavijñānavigrahaḥ .
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ na jānāmi kathaṃ kasyāpi vartate ..1-7..
verses.colloquial:
aham eva avyayo anantah shuddha vijnaana vigrahah |
sukham duhkham na jaanaami katham kasya api vartate ..1-7..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly I am indestructible and infinite, pure consciousness itself. I do not know how happiness and sorrow are experienced, or who it is that experiences them.

verses.sanskrit:
न मानसं कर्म शुभाशुभं मे
न कायिकं कर्म शुभाशुभं मे ।
न वाचिकं कर्म शुभाशुभं मे
ज्ञानामृतं शुद्धमतीन्द्रियोऽहम् ॥ १-८॥
verses.roman:
na mānasaṃ karma śubhāśubhaṃ me
na kāyikaṃ karma śubhāśubhaṃ me .
na vācikaṃ karma śubhāśubhaṃ me
jñānāmṛtaṃ śuddhamatīndriyo'ham ..1-8..
verses.colloquial:
na maanasam karma shubha ashubham me
na kaayikam karma shubha ashubham me |
na vaachikam karma shubha ashubham me
jnaana amritam shuddham atiindriyah aham ..1-8..
verses.translation_reworded: For me there is no act of mind, good or bad; for me there is no act of body, good or bad; for me there is no act of speech, good or bad. I am undying consciousness, pure and beyond all.

verses.sanskrit:
मनो वै गगनाकारं मनो वै सर्वतोमुखम् ।
मनोऽतीतं मनः सर्वं न मनः परमार्थतः ॥ १-९॥
verses.roman:
mano vai gaganākāraṃ mano vai sarvatomukham .
mano'tītaṃ manaḥ sarvaṃ na manaḥ paramārthataḥ ..1-9..
verses.colloquial:
mano vai gaganaakaaram mano vai sarvato mukham .
mano atiitam manah sarvam na manah paramaarthatah ..1-9..
verses.translation_reworded: The mind is truly like space: it seems to face every direction, it seems to go beyond everything, it seems to be everything. Yet in reality the mind does not exist at all.

verses.sanskrit:
अहमेकमिदं सर्वं व्योमातीतं निरन्तरम् ।
पश्यामि कथमात्मानं प्रत्यक्षं वा तिरोहितम् ॥ १-१०॥
verses.roman:
ahamekamidaṃ sarvaṃ vyomātītaṃ nirantaram .
paśyāmi kathamātmānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vā tirohitam ..1-10..
verses.colloquial:
aham ekam idam sarvam vyoma atiitam nirantaram |
pashyaami katham aatmaanam pratyaksham vaa tirohitam ..1-10..
verses.translation_reworded: I am one, and I am in all things. I am limitless and beyond space. How could I see my own Self coming into being or passing away?

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमेवमेकं हि कथं न बुध्यसे
समं हि सर्वेषु विमृष्टमव्ययम् ।
सदोदितोऽसि त्वमखण्डितः प्रभो
दिवा च नक्तं च कथं हि मन्यसे ॥ १-११॥
verses.roman:
tvamevamekaṃ hi kathaṃ na budhyase
samaṃ hi sarveṣu vimṛṣṭamavyayam .
sadodito'si tvamakhaṇḍitaḥ prabho
divā ca naktaṃ ca kathaṃ hi manyase ..1-11..
verses.colloquial:
tvam evam ekam hi katham na budhyase
samam hi sarveshu vimrishtam avyayam .
sad udito asi tvam akhanditah prabho
divaa cha naktam cha katham hi manyase ..1-11..
verses.translation_reworded: Why do you not grasp that you yourself are that absolute One? You are the eternal Atman, reflecting all things alike. You are the Lord whom nothing can refute, forever shining. How then can you think in terms of day (light) or night (darkness)?

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मानं सततं विद्धि सर्वत्रैकं निरन्तरम् ।
अहं ध्याता परं ध्येयमखण्डं खण्ड्यते कथम् ॥ १-१२॥
verses.roman:
ātmānaṃ satataṃ viddhi sarvatraikaṃ nirantaram .
ahaṃ dhyātā paraṃ dhyeyamakhaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍyate katham ..1-12..
verses.colloquial:
aatmaanam satatam viddhi sarvatra ekam nirantaram .
aham dhyaataa param dhyeyam akhandam khandyate katham ..1-12..
verses.translation_reworded: Stay aware of the Atman at all times; It is unbroken and everywhere the same. You say, "I am the one who meditates," and "the Supreme One is what I meditate upon." Why do you split what cannot be split?

verses.sanskrit:
न जातो न मृतोऽसि त्वं न ते देहः कदाचन ।
सर्वं ब्रह्मेति विख्यातं ब्रवीति बहुधा श्रुतिः ॥ १-१३॥
verses.roman:
na jāto na mṛto'si tvaṃ na te dehaḥ kadācana .
sarvaṃ brahmeti vikhyātaṃ bravīti bahudhā śrutiḥ ..1-13..
verses.colloquial:
na jaato na mrito asi tvam na te dehah kadaacana .
sarvam brahmeti vikhyaatam braviiti bahudhaa shrutih ..1-13..
verses.translation_reworded: You were never born and you will never die. You have never possessed a body. In many different ways the Upanishads proclaim this declared truth: "All is Brahman."

verses.sanskrit:
स बाह्याभ्यन्तरोऽसि त्वं शिवः सर्वत्र सर्वदा ।
इतस्ततः कथं भ्रान्तः प्रधावसि पिशाचवत् ॥ १-१४॥
verses.roman:
sa bāhyābhyantaro'si tvaṃ śivaḥ sarvatra sarvadā .
itastataḥ kathaṃ bhrāntaḥ pradhāvasi piśācavat ..1-14..
verses.colloquial:
sa baahya abhyantaro asi tvam shivah sarvatra sarvadaa .
itas tatah katham bhraantah pradhaavasi pishaacavat ..1-14..
verses.translation_reworded: You are always present, both inside and outside. You are that Supreme Bliss, at every time and in every place. Why then do you rush here and there like a bewildered ghost?

verses.sanskrit:
संयोगश्च वियोगश्च वर्तते न च ते न मे ।
न त्वं नाहं जगन्नेदं सर्वमात्मैव केवलम् ॥ १-१५॥
verses.roman:
saṃyogaśca viyogaśca vartate na ca te na me .
na tvaṃ nāhaṃ jagannedaṃ sarvamātmaiva kevalam ..1-15..
verses.colloquial:
samyogash cha viyogash cha vartate na cha te na me |
na tvam na aham jagan na idam sarvam aatmaiva kevalam ..1-15..
verses.translation_reworded: Between you and me there can be no joining and no parting. In reality neither you nor I nor this world exists. The Atman alone remains.

verses.sanskrit:
शब्दादिपञ्चकस्यास्य नैवासि त्वं न ते पुनः ।
त्वमेव परमं तत्त्वमतः किं परितप्यसे ॥ १-१६॥
verses.roman:
śabdādipañcakasyāsya naivāsi tvaṃ na te punaḥ .
tvameva paramaṃ tattvamataḥ kiṃ paritapyase ..1-16..
verses.colloquial:
shabda aadi panca kasya asya na eva asi tvam na te punah |
tvam eva paramam tattvam ata kim paritapyase .. 1-16..
verses.translation_reworded: You do not belong to the five sense-objects, such as sound, touch, form, taste, and smell, and they in turn do not belong to you. You are indeed that Supreme Reality. What reason, then, do you have for grief?

verses.sanskrit:
जन्म मृत्युर्न ते चित्तं बन्धमोक्षौ शुभाशुभौ ।
कथं रोदिषि रे वत्स नामरूपं न ते न मे ॥ १-१७॥
verses.roman:
janma mṛtyurna te cittaṃ bandhamokṣau śubhāśubhau .
kathaṃ rodiṣi re vatsa nāmarūpaṃ na te na me ..1-17..
verses.colloquial:
janma mrityur na te cittam bandha mokshau shubha ashubhau |
katham rodishi re vatsa naama ruupam na te na me ..1-17..
verses.translation_reworded: You have no birth and no death, no memory, no bondage and no liberation, no good and no evil. Why do you cry, my dear one? Name and form belong neither to you nor to me.

verses.sanskrit:
अहो चित्त कथं भ्रान्तः प्रधावसि पिशाचवत् ।
अभिन्नं पश्य चात्मानं रागत्यागात्सुखी भव ॥ १-१८॥
verses.roman:
aho citta kathaṃ bhrāntaḥ pradhāvasi piśācavat .
abhinnaṃ paśya cātmānaṃ rāgatyāgātsukhī bhava ..1-18..
verses.colloquial:
aho citta katham bhraantah pradhaavasi pishaacavat .
abhinnam pashya ca aatmaanam raaga tyaagaat sukhii bhava ..1-18..
verses.translation_reworded: O mind, why do you roam about like a restless ghost? Realize the Atman, in which there are no distinctions. Let go of every craving and be happy.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमेव तत्त्वं हि विकारवर्जितं
निष्कम्पमेकं हि विमोक्षविग्रहम् ।
न ते च रागो ह्यथवा विरागः
कथं हि सन्तप्यसि कामकामतः ॥ १-१९॥
verses.roman:
tvameva tattvaṃ hi vikāravarjitaṃ
niṣkampamekaṃ hi vimokṣavigraham .
na te ca rāgo hyathavā virāgaḥ
kathaṃ hi santapyasi kāmakāmataḥ ..1-19..
verses.colloquial:
tvam eva tattvam hi vikaara varjitam
nishkampam ekam hi vimoksha vigraham .
na te ca raago hi athavaa viraagah
katham hi santapyasi kaama kaamatah ..1-19..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly, you are that unchanging Reality, which is still, one, and freedom itself. You feel neither passion nor dispassion. Why then do you torment yourself by craving objects of lust?

verses.sanskrit:
वदन्ति श्रुतयः सर्वाः निर्गुणं शुद्धमव्ययम् ।
अशरीरं समं तत्त्वं तन्मां विद्धि न संशयः ॥ १-२०॥
verses.roman:
vadanti śrutayaḥ sarvāḥ nirguṇaṃ śuddhamavyayam .
aśarīraṃ samaṃ tattvaṃ tanmāṃ viddhi na saṃśayaḥ ..1-20..
verses.colloquial:
vadanti shrutayah sarvaah nirgunam shuddham avyayam |
ashariiram samam tattvam tan maam viddhi na samshayah ..1-20..
verses.translation_reworded: Every Upanishad declares that Brahman, the Supreme Reality, is without attributes, pure, unchanging, bodiless, and equally present in all things. Know that I am that Brahman. Have no doubt about this.

verses.sanskrit:
साकारमनृतं विद्धि निराकारं निरन्तरम् ।
एतत्तत्त्वोपदेशेन न पुनर्भवसम्भवः ॥ १-२१॥
verses.roman:
sākāramanṛtaṃ viddhi nirākāraṃ nirantaram .
etattattvopadeśena na punarbhavasambhavaḥ ..1-21..
verses.colloquial:
saakaaram anritam viddhi niraakaaram nirantaram |
etat tattva upadeshena na punar bhava sambhavah ..1-21..
verses.translation_reworded: Know this: whatever has form is unreal (since it is limited by its form); whatever is formless is eternal. One who lives out this truth in his own life will not be born again.

verses.sanskrit:
एकमेव समं तत्त्वं वदन्ति हि विपश्चितः ।
रागत्यागात्पुनश्चित्तमेकानेकं न विद्यते ॥ १-२२॥
verses.roman:
ekameva samaṃ tattvaṃ vadanti hi vipaścitaḥ .
rāgatyāgātpunaścittamekānekaṃ na vidyate ..1-22..
verses.colloquial:
ekam eva samam tattvam vadanti hi vipashcitah |
raaga tyaagaat punash cittam eka anekam na vidyate ..1-22..
verses.translation_reworded: The sages declare that Reality is one and never changes. Once craving is given up, both unity and diversity vanish from the mind.

verses.sanskrit:
अनात्मरूपं च कथं समाधि-
रात्मस्वरूपं च कथं समाधिः ।
अस्तीति नास्तीति कथं समाधि-
र्मोक्षस्वरूपं यदि सर्वमेकम् ॥ १-२३॥
verses.roman:
anātmarūpaṃ ca kathaṃ samādhi-
rātmasvarūpaṃ ca kathaṃ samādhiḥ .
astīti nāstīti kathaṃ samādhi-
rmokṣasvarūpaṃ yadi sarvamekam ..1-23..
verses.colloquial:
anaatma ruupam ca katham samaadhi
raatma svaruupam ca katham samaadhih |
astiiti naastiiti katham samaadhi
rmoksha svaruupam yadi sarvam ekam ..1-23..
verses.translation_reworded: How can a man reach samadhi while he takes himself to be something other than the Atman? Yet samadhi is also impossible for a man who thinks of himself as the Atman. How can samadhi be reached while a man thinks that the Atman both exists and does not exist? And what need is there to reach samadhi at all, if everything is one and free by nature?

verses.sanskrit:
विशुद्धोऽसि समं तत्त्वं विदेहस्त्वमजोऽव्ययः ।
जानामीह न जानामीत्यात्मानं मन्यसे कथम् ॥ १-२४॥
verses.roman:
viśuddho'si samaṃ tattvaṃ videhastvamajo'vyayaḥ .
jānāmīha na jānāmītyātmānaṃ manyase katham ..1-24..
verses.colloquial:
vishuddho asi samam tattvam videhas tvam ajo avyayah |
jaanaamiiha na jaanaamiity aatmaanam manyase katham ..1-24..
verses.translation_reworded: You are the Reality, forever pure and unchanging. You have no body, no birth, and no death. Why do you think in terms such as "I know the Atman" or "I do not know It"?

verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्वमस्यादिवाक्येन स्वात्मा हि प्रतिपादितः ।
नेति नेति श्रुतिर्ब्रूयादनृतं पाञ्चभौतिकम् ॥ १-२५॥
verses.roman:
tattvamasyādivākyena svātmā hi pratipāditaḥ .
neti neti śrutirbrūyādanṛtaṃ pāñcabhautikam ..1-25..
verses.colloquial:
tattvam asi aadi vaakyena svaatmaa hi pratipaaditah |
na iti na iti shrutir bruuyaad anritam paanca bhautikam ..1-25..
verses.translation_reworded: The Atman, the true nature of existence, is established by the great Vedic sayings such as "Thou art That" and "I am Brahman." The body, made of the five elements, is unreal; the Upanishads declare this with the words "Not this, not this."

verses.sanskrit:
आत्मन्येवात्मना सर्वं त्वया पूर्णं निरन्तरम् ।
ध्याता ध्यानं न ते चित्तं निर्लज्जं ध्यायते कथम् ॥ १-२६॥
verses.roman:
ātmanyevātmanā sarvaṃ tvayā pūrṇaṃ nirantaram .
dhyātā dhyānaṃ na te cittaṃ nirlajjaṃ dhyāyate katham ..1-26..
verses.colloquial:
aatmany eva aatmanaa sarvam tvayaa puurnam nirantaram .
dhyaataa dhyaanam na te cittam nirlajjam dhyaayate katham ..1-26..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly, everything in this universe is filled completely by your Atman alone. So in your mind there is neither a meditator nor any meditation. How can you go on meditating without feeling any shame?

verses.sanskrit:
शिवं न जानामि कथं वदामि
शिवं न जानामि कथं भजामि ।
अहं शिवश्चेत्परमार्थतत्त्वं
समस्वरूपं गगनोपमं च ॥ १-२७॥
verses.roman:
śivaṃ na jānāmi kathaṃ vadāmi
śivaṃ na jānāmi kathaṃ bhajāmi .
ahaṃ śivaścetparamārthatattvaṃ
samasvarūpaṃ gaganopamaṃ ca ..1-27..
verses.colloquial:
shivam na jaanaami katham vadaami
shivam na jaanaami katham bhajaami .
aham shivash cet paramaartha tattvam
sama svaruupam gagana upamam cha ..1-27..
verses.translation_reworded: How can I speak of or worship that Supreme Bliss, which I cannot know as an object of knowledge? For I myself am that Supreme Bliss, the Ultimate Reality, complete by nature and pervading all like space.

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं तत्त्वं समं तत्त्वं कल्पनाहेतुवर्जितम् ।
ग्राह्यग्राहकनिर्मुक्तं स्वसंवेद्यं कथं भवेत् ॥ १-२८॥
verses.roman:
nāhaṃ tattvaṃ samaṃ tattvaṃ kalpanāhetuvarjitam .
grāhyagrāhakanirmuktaṃ svasaṃvedyaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ..1-28..
verses.colloquial:
na aham tattvam samam tattvam kalpanaa hetu varjitam |
graahya graahaka nirmuktam sva samvedyam katham bhavet ..1-28..
verses.translation_reworded: I am not the cosmic principles. I am that same Reality, beyond inference and reasoning, free of both subject and object. How could I know my own Self?

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्तरूपं न हि वस्तु किञ्चि-
त्तत्त्वस्वरूपं न हि वस्तु किञ्चित् ।
आत्मैकरूपं परमार्थतत्त्वं
न हिंसको वापि न चाप्यहिंसा ॥ १-२९॥
verses.roman:
anantarūpaṃ na hi vastu kiñci-
ttattvasvarūpaṃ na hi vastu kiñcit .
ātmaikarūpaṃ paramārthatattvaṃ
na hiṃsako vāpi na cāpyahiṃsā ..1-29..
verses.colloquial:
ananta ruupam na hi vastu kinci
t tattva svaruupam na hi vastu kincit |
aatma eka ruupam parama artha tattvam
na himsako vaapi na ca api ahimsaa ..1-29..
verses.translation_reworded: No object can be infinite by nature. Matter cannot be Reality Itself. Truly, the Atman alone is the Supreme Reality. It is neither harmful nor harmless.

verses.sanskrit:
विशुद्धोऽसि समं तत्त्वं विदेहमजमव्ययम् ।
विभ्रमं कथमात्मार्थे विभ्रान्तोऽहं कथं पुनः ॥ १-३०॥
verses.roman:
viśuddho'si samaṃ tattvaṃ videhamajamavyayam .
vibhramaṃ kathamātmārthe vibhrānto'haṃ kathaṃ punaḥ ..1-30..
verses.colloquial:
vishuddho asi samam tattvam videham ajam avyayam |
vibhramam katham aatmaarthe vibhraanto aham katham punah ..1-30..
verses.translation_reworded: You are that pure, bodiless, unborn, indestructible, unchanging Reality. How could there be any confusion about the Atman? And how, then, can you say, "I am confused"?

verses.sanskrit:
घटे भिन्ने घटाकाशं सुलीनं भेदवर्जितम् ।
शिवेन मनसा शुद्धो न भेदः प्रतिभाति मे ॥ १-३१॥
verses.roman:
ghaṭe bhinne ghaṭākāśaṃ sulīnaṃ bhedavarjitam .
śivena manasā śuddho na bhedaḥ pratibhāti me ..1-31..
verses.colloquial:
ghate bhinne ghataakaasham suliinam bheda varjitam |
shivena manasaa shuddho na bhedah pratibhaati me ..1-31..
verses.translation_reworded: When a jar breaks, the space inside the jar merges completely into undivided space. In the same way, when the mind is purified, it merges into the Supreme Bliss. Hence I perceive no diversity.

verses.sanskrit:
न घटो न घटाकाशो न जीवो जीवविग्रहः ।
केवलं ब्रह्म संविद्धि वेद्यवेदकवर्जितम् ॥ १-३२॥
verses.roman:
na ghaṭo na ghaṭākāśo na jīvo jīvavigrahaḥ .
kevalaṃ brahma saṃviddhi vedyavedakavarjitam ..1-32..
verses.colloquial:
na ghato na ghataakaasho na jiivo jiiva vigrahah |
kevalam brahma samviddhi vedya vedaka varjitam ..1-32..
verses.translation_reworded: Distinctions like jar and jar-space, or individual body and individual soul, do not exist in Brahman. Realize that Absolute Brahman, which can neither be known nor be made known.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वत्र सर्वदा सर्वमात्मानं सततं ध्रुवम् ।
सर्वं शून्यमशून्यं च तन्मां विद्धि न संशयः ॥ १-३३॥
verses.roman:
sarvatra sarvadā sarvamātmānaṃ satataṃ dhruvam .
sarvaṃ śūnyamaśūnyaṃ ca tanmāṃ viddhi na saṃśayaḥ ..1-33..
verses.colloquial:
sarvatra sarvadaa sarvam aatmaanam satatam dhruvam .
sarvam shuunyam ashuunyam cha tan maam viddhi na samshayah ..1-33..
verses.translation_reworded: The Atman exists at all times, in all places, and in all things. It is eternal and unchanging. Everything in this world is empty, and at the same time it is full of the Atman. Realize: I am that Atman. Have no doubt about it.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदा न लोका न सुरा न यज्ञा
वर्णाश्रमो नैव कुलं न जातिः ।
न धूममार्गो न च दीप्तिमार्गो
ब्रह्मैकरूपं परमार्थतत्त्वम् ॥ १-३४॥
verses.roman:
vedā na lokā na surā na yajñā
varṇāśramo naiva kulaṃ na jātiḥ .
na dhūmamārgo na ca dīptimārgo
brahmaikarūpaṃ paramārthatattvam ..1-34..
verses.colloquial:
vedaa na lokaa na suraa na yajnaa
varnaashramo naiva kulam na jaatih .
na dhuuma maargo na ca diipti maargo
brahmaika ruupam paramaartha tattvam ..1-34..
verses.translation_reworded: In Brahman there are no Vedas, no worlds, no gods, no sacrifices; no stages of life, no castes, no race, no lineage; neither the path of smoke nor the path of light. Only that same Brahman, the Supreme Reality, exists.

verses.sanskrit:
व्याप्यव्यापकनिर्मुक्तः त्वमेकः सफलं यदि ।
प्रत्यक्षं चापरोक्षं च ह्यात्मानं मन्यसे कथम् ॥ १-३५॥
verses.roman:
vyāpyavyāpakanirmuktaḥ tvamekaḥ saphalaṃ yadi .
pratyakṣaṃ cāparokṣaṃ ca hyātmānaṃ manyase katham ..1-35..
verses.colloquial:
vyaapya vyaapaka nirmukta tvam ekah saphalam yadi |
pratyaksham cha aparoksham cha hi aatmaanam manyase katham ..1-35..
verses.translation_reworded: If you have realized that Absolute One, free of both pervader and pervaded, how can you regard the Atman as either perceptible or imperceptible?

verses.sanskrit:
अद्वैतं केचिदिच्छन्ति द्वैतमिच्छन्ति चापरे ।
समं तत्त्वं न विन्दन्ति द्वैताद्वैतविवर्जितम् ॥ १-३६॥
verses.roman:
advaitaṃ kecidicchanti dvaitamicchanti cāpare .
samaṃ tattvaṃ na vindanti dvaitādvaitavivarjitam ..1-36..
verses.colloquial:
advaitam kecid icchanti dvaitam icchanti ca apare |
samam tattvam na vindanti dvaita advaita vivarjitam ..1-36..
verses.translation_reworded: Some choose to be non-dualists and others choose to be dualists, but none of them truly knows that same Brahman, which is free of both duality and non-duality.

verses.sanskrit:
श्वेतादिवर्णरहितं शब्दादिगुणवर्जितम् ।
कथयन्ति कथं तत्त्वं मनोवाचामगोचरम् ॥ १-३७॥
verses.roman:
śvetādivarṇarahitaṃ śabdādiguṇavarjitam .
kathayanti kathaṃ tattvaṃ manovācāmagocaram ..1-37..
verses.colloquial:
shvetaadi varna rahitam shabdaadi guna varjitam |
kathayanti katham tattvam mano vaacaam agocaram ..1-37..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman has no colours such as white, blue, or yellow; It has no qualities such as sound, touch, or smell. How can people describe Brahman, which lies beyond mind and speech?

verses.sanskrit:
यदाऽनृतमिदं सर्वं देहादिगगनोपमम् ।
तदा हि ब्रह्म संवेत्ति न ते द्वैतपरम्परा ॥ १-३८॥
verses.roman:
yadā'nṛtamidaṃ sarvaṃ dehādigaganopamam .
tadā hi brahma saṃvetti na te dvaitaparamparā ..1-38..
verses.colloquial:
yadaa anritam idam sarvam deha aadi gagana upamam |
tadaa hi brahma samvetti na te dvaita paramparaa ..1-38..
verses.translation_reworded: When everything in this world, the body included, becomes unreal and empty like space, then one truly knows Brahman. For such a person there is no longer any procession of dualities.

verses.sanskrit:
परेण सहजात्मापि ह्यभिन्नः प्रतिभाति मे ।
व्योमाकारं तथैवैकं ध्याता ध्यानं कथं भवेत् ॥ १-३९॥
verses.roman:
pareṇa sahajātmāpi hyabhinnaḥ pratibhāti me .
vyomākāraṃ tathaivaikaṃ dhyātā dhyānaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ..1-39..
verses.colloquial:
parena saha jaatmaa api hi abhinnah pratibhaati me |
vyoma aakaaram tatha eva ekam dhyaataa dhyaanam katham bhavet ..1-39..
verses.translation_reworded: It seems to me that my own inner self and the Supreme Self are truly one and the same, exactly like a single unbroken space. How then can there be a meditator and a meditation?

verses.sanskrit:
यत्करोमि यदश्नामि यज्जुहोमि ददामि यत् ।
एतत्सर्वं न मे किञ्चिद्विशुद्धोऽहमजोऽव्ययः ॥ १-४०॥
verses.roman:
yatkaromi yadaśnāmi yajjuhomi dadāmi yat .
etatsarvaṃ na me kiñcidviśuddho'hamajo'vyayaḥ ..1-40..
verses.colloquial:
yat karomi yad ashnaami yaj juhomi dadaami yat |
etat sarvam na me kinchid vishuddho aham ajo avyayah ..1-40..
verses.translation_reworded: Whatever I do, whatever I eat, whatever I offer in sacrifice, whatever I give away: none of it belongs to me. I am forever pure, unborn, and unchanging.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वं जगद्विद्धि निराकृतीदं
सर्वं जगद्विद्धि विकारहीनम् ।
सर्वं जगद्विद्धि विशुद्धदेहं
सर्वं जगद्विद्धि शिवैकरूपम् ॥ १-४१॥
verses.roman:
sarvaṃ jagadviddhi nirākṛtīdaṃ
sarvaṃ jagadviddhi vikārahīnam .
sarvaṃ jagadviddhi viśuddhadehaṃ
sarvaṃ jagadviddhi śivaikarūpam ..1-41..
verses.colloquial:
sarvam jagad viddhi niraakriti idam
sarvam jagad viddhi vikaara hiinam .
sarvam jagad viddhi vishuddha deham
sarvam jagad viddhi shiva eka ruupam ..1-41..
verses.translation_reworded: Know this entire universe to be without form. Know this entire universe to be without change. Know this entire universe to be pure existence itself. Know this entire universe to be of the nature of Supreme Bliss.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्वं त्वं न हि सन्देहः किं जानाम्यथवा पुनः ।
असंवेद्यं स्वसंवेद्यमात्मानं मन्यसे कथम् ॥ १-४२॥
verses.roman:
tattvaṃ tvaṃ na hi sandehaḥ kiṃ jānāmyathavā punaḥ .
asaṃvedyaṃ svasaṃvedyamātmānaṃ manyase katham ..1-42..
verses.colloquial:
tattvam tvam na hi sandehah kim jaanaamy athavaa punah |
asamvedyam svasamvedyam aatmaanam manyase katham ..1-42..
verses.translation_reworded: Beyond doubt, you are that Supreme Reality. Why then do you wonder, "Do I know the Atman or not?" or "Is It something experienced, or is It beyond comprehension?"

verses.sanskrit:
मायाऽमाया कथं तात छायाऽछाया न विद्यते ।
तत्त्वमेकमिदं सर्वं व्योमाकारं निरञ्जनम् ॥ १-४३॥
verses.roman:
māyā'māyā kathaṃ tāta chāyā'chāyā na vidyate .
tattvamekamidaṃ sarvaṃ vyomākāraṃ nirañjanam ..1-43..
verses.colloquial:
maayaa amaayaa katham taata chaayaa achaayaa na vidyate .
tattvam ekam idam sarvam vyoma aakaaram niranjanam ..1-43..
verses.translation_reworded: My dear one, just as darkness and light cannot exist together, how could ignorance and knowledge both be present in Brahman? All of this is that one spotless, formless Reality.

verses.sanskrit:
आदिमध्यान्तमुक्तोऽहं न बद्धोऽहं कदाचन ।
स्वभावनिर्मलः शुद्ध इति मे निश्चिता मतिः ॥ १-४४॥
verses.roman:
ādimadhyāntamukto'haṃ na baddho'haṃ kadācana .
svabhāvanirmalaḥ śuddha iti me niścitā matiḥ ..1-44..
verses.colloquial:
aadi madhya anta mukto aham na baddho aham kadaacana |
svabhaava nirmalah shuddha iti me nishchitaa matih ..1-44..
verses.translation_reworded: I have no beginning, no middle, and no end. I am never bound. By nature I am pure and perfect; of this I am firmly convinced.

verses.sanskrit:
महदादि जगत्सर्वं न किञ्चित्प्रतिभाति मे ।
ब्रह्मैव केवलं सर्वं कथं वर्णाश्रमस्थितिः ॥ १-४५॥
verses.roman:
mahadādi jagatsarvaṃ na kiñcitpratibhāti me .
brahmaiva kevalaṃ sarvaṃ kathaṃ varṇāśramasthitiḥ ..1-45..
verses.colloquial:
mahad aadi jagat sarvam na kincit pratibhaati me .
brahmaiva kevalam sarvam katham varnaashrama sthitih ..1-45..
verses.translation_reworded: I perceive nothing, from the cosmic intelligence down to the manifest universe. Truly, all of this is Brahman. How can caste and the stages of life continue to apply?

verses.sanskrit:
जानामि सर्वथा सर्वमहमेको निरन्तरम् ।
निरालम्बमशून्यं च शून्यं व्योमादिपञ्चकम् ॥ १-४६॥
verses.roman:
jānāmi sarvathā sarvamahameko nirantaram .
nirālambamaśūnyaṃ ca śūnyaṃ vyomādipañcakam ..1-46..
verses.colloquial:
jaanaami sarvathaa sarvam aham eko nirantaram |
niraalambam ashuunyam cha shuunyam vyoma aadi panchakam ..1-46..
verses.translation_reworded: I know in every way that I am the one Reality, pervading all, independent, and existing forever. The five elements, space, air, fire, water, and earth, are all unreal.

verses.sanskrit:
न षण्ढो न पुमान्न स्त्री न बोधो नैव कल्पना ।
सानन्दो वा निरानन्दमात्मानं मन्यसे कथम् ॥ १-४७॥
verses.roman:
na ṣaṇḍho na pumānna strī na bodho naiva kalpanā .
sānando vā nirānandamātmānaṃ manyase katham ..1-47..
verses.colloquial:
na shando na pumaan na strii na bodho naiva kalpanaa .
saanando vaa niraanandam aatmaanam manyase katham ..1-47..
verses.translation_reworded: The Atman is not male, not female, and not neuter. It is not an object of perception or inference. Why then do you brood over whether the Atman is blissful or without bliss?

verses.sanskrit:
षडङ्गयोगान्न तु नैव शुद्धं
मनोविनाशान्न तु नैव शुद्धम् ।
गुरूपदेशान्न तु नैव शुद्धं
स्वयं च तत्त्वं स्वयमेव बुद्धम् ॥ १-४८॥
verses.roman:
ṣaḍaṅgayogānna tu naiva śuddhaṃ
manovināśānna tu naiva śuddham .
gurūpadeśānna tu naiva śuddhaṃ
svayaṃ ca tattvaṃ svayameva buddham ..1-48..
verses.colloquial:
shad anga yogaan na tu naiva shuddham
mano vinaashaan na tu naiva shuddham .
guru upadeshaan na tu naiva shuddham
svayam ca tattvam svayam eva buddham ..1-48..
verses.translation_reworded: The Atman cannot be purified by practising the six limbs of yoga, by destroying the mind, or by a teacher's instruction. The Atman is Reality Itself and Purity Itself.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि पञ्चात्मको देहो विदेहो वर्तते न हि ।
आत्मैव केवलं सर्वं तुरीयं च त्रयं कथम् ॥ १-४९॥
verses.roman:
na hi pañcātmako deho videho vartate na hi .
ātmaiva kevalaṃ sarvaṃ turīyaṃ ca trayaṃ katham ..1-49..
verses.colloquial:
na hi panca aatmako deho videho vartate na hi .
aatmaiva kevalam sarvam turiiyam ca trayam katham ..1-49..
verses.translation_reworded: The Atman neither has a body made of the five elements nor is It bodiless. Truly, everything is the Atman. How can the three states, and the Fourth, be attributed to the Atman?

verses.sanskrit:
न बद्धो नैव मुक्तोऽहं न चाहं ब्रह्मणः पृथक् ।
न कर्ता न च भोक्ताहं व्याप्यव्यापकवर्जितः ॥ १-५०॥
verses.roman:
na baddho naiva mukto'haṃ na cāhaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pṛthak .
na kartā na ca bhoktāhaṃ vyāpyavyāpakavarjitaḥ ..1-50..
verses.colloquial:
na baddho naiva mukto aham na ca aham brahmanah prithak |
na kartaa na ca bhoktaa aham vyaapya vyaapaka varjitah ..1-50..
verses.translation_reworded: In truth I am neither bound nor free, nor am I separate from Brahman. I am neither the doer nor the one who enjoys, neither the pervader nor the pervaded.

verses.sanskrit:
यथा जलं जले न्यस्तं सलिलं भेदवर्जितम् ।
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं तद्वदभिन्नं प्रतिभाति मे ॥ १-५१॥
verses.roman:
yathā jalaṃ jale nyastaṃ salilaṃ bhedavarjitam .
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ tadvadabhinnaṃ pratibhāti me ..1-51..
verses.colloquial:
yathaa jalam jale nyastam salilam bheda varjitam |
prakritim purusham tadvad abhinnam pratibhaati me ..1-51..
verses.translation_reworded: Just as water poured into water remains the same undivided water, so prakriti (matter) and Purusha (Spirit) both appear to me as one and the same.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि नाम न मुक्तोऽसि न बद्धोऽसि कदाचन ।
साकारं च निराकारमात्मानं मन्यसे कथम् ॥ १-५२॥
verses.roman:
yadi nāma na mukto'si na baddho'si kadācana .
sākāraṃ ca nirākāramātmānaṃ manyase katham ..1-52..
verses.colloquial:
yadi naama na mukto asi na baddho asi kadaacana |
saakaaram ca niraakaaram aatmaanam manyase katham ..1-52..
verses.translation_reworded: If you are indeed not free, then neither have you ever been bound. How then can you think of yourself as having form (when bound) or as formless (when liberated)?

verses.sanskrit:
जानामि ते परं रूपं प्रत्यक्षं गगनोपमम् ।
यथा परं हि रूपं यन्मरीचिजलसन्निभम् ॥ १-५३॥
verses.roman:
jānāmi te paraṃ rūpaṃ pratyakṣaṃ gaganopamam .
yathā paraṃ hi rūpaṃ yanmarīcijalasannibham ..1-53..
verses.colloquial:
jaanaami te param ruupam pratyaksham gagana upamam |
yathaa param hi ruupam yan mariici jala sannibham ..1-53..
verses.translation_reworded: I know your supreme form, which is ever present and pervades everything like space. Likewise I know your lower form, which is indeed like the water of a mirage.

verses.sanskrit:
न गुरुर्नोपदेशश्च न चोपाधिर्न मे क्रिया ।
विदेहं गगनं विद्धि विशुद्धोऽहं स्वभावतः ॥ १-५४॥
verses.roman:
na gururnopadeśaśca na copādhirna me kriyā .
videhaṃ gaganaṃ viddhi viśuddho'haṃ svabhāvataḥ ..1-54..
verses.colloquial:
na gurur nopadeshash ca na copaadhir na me kriyaa |
videham gaganam viddhi vishuddho aham svabhaavatah ..1-54..
verses.translation_reworded: I have no guru and no teaching, no attributes and no action. Know for certain that I am without body, like space, and absolutely pure by nature.

verses.sanskrit:
विशुद्धोऽस्य शरीरोऽसि न ते चित्तं परात्परम् ।
अहं चात्मा परं तत्त्वमिति वक्तुं न लज्जसे ॥ १-५५॥
verses.roman:
viśuddho'sya śarīro'si na te cittaṃ parātparam .
ahaṃ cātmā paraṃ tattvamiti vaktuṃ na lajjase ..1-55..
verses.colloquial:
vishuddho asya shariiro asi na te cittam paraatparam |
aham ca aatmaa param tattvam iti vaktum na lajjase ..1-55..
verses.translation_reworded: You are absolutely pure. You have no body and no mind, and you are beyond maya. Do not be ashamed to declare, "I am the Atman, the Supreme Reality."

verses.sanskrit:
कथं रोदिषि रे चित्त ह्यात्मैवात्मात्मना भव ।
पिब वत्स कलातीतमद्वैतं परमामृतम् ॥ १-५६॥
verses.roman:
kathaṃ rodiṣi re citta hyātmaivātmātmanā bhava .
piba vatsa kalātītamadvaitaṃ paramāmṛtam ..1-56..
verses.colloquial:
katham rodishi re citta hi aatmaiva aatma aatmanaa bhava |
piba vatsa kalaatiitam advaitam paramaamritam ..1-56..
verses.translation_reworded: O mind, why do you weep? You truly are the Atman. Become one with It. Drink, my dear one, the supreme nectar of the limitless ocean of non-dual Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
नैव बोधो न चाबोधो न बोधाबोध एव च ।
यस्येदृशः सदा बोधः स बोधो नान्यथा भवेत् ॥ १-५७॥
verses.roman:
naiva bodho na cābodho na bodhābodha eva ca .
yasyedṛśaḥ sadā bodhaḥ sa bodho nānyathā bhavet ..1-57..
verses.colloquial:
naiva bodho na cha abodho na bodha abodha eva cha |
yasya iidrishah sadaa bodhah sa bodho na anyathaa bhavet ..1-57..
verses.translation_reworded: In the Atman there is no knowledge, no ignorance, and no mixture of the two. Whoever holds this knowledge at all times becomes knowledge Itself and nothing else.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानं न तर्को न समाधियोगो
न देशकालौ न गुरूपदेशः ।
स्वभावसंवित्तरहं च तत्त्व-
माकाशकल्पं सहजं ध्रुवं च ॥ १-५८॥
verses.roman:
jñānaṃ na tarko na samādhiyogo
na deśakālau na gurūpadeśaḥ .
svabhāvasaṃvittarahaṃ ca tattva-
mākāśakalpaṃ sahajaṃ dhruvaṃ ca ..1-58..
verses.colloquial:
jnaanam na tarko na samaadhi yogo
na desha kaalau na guru upadeshah .
svabhaava samvittar aham cha tattva
maakaasha kalpam sahajam dhruvam cha ..1-58..
verses.translation_reworded: Knowledge of the Self does not rest on reasoning, on the practice of meditation, on a guru's instruction, or on anything within space and time. By nature I am that absolute Knowledge, the Reality that is innate, eternal, and as boundless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
न जातोऽहं मृतो वापि न मे कर्म शुभाशुभम् ।
विशुद्धं निर्गुणं ब्रह्म बन्धो मुक्तिः कथं मम ॥ १-५९॥
verses.roman:
na jāto'haṃ mṛto vāpi na me karma śubhāśubham .
viśuddhaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma bandho muktiḥ kathaṃ mama ..1-59..
verses.colloquial:
na jaato aham mrito vaapi na me karma shubha ashubham .
vishuddham nirgunam brahma bandho muktih katham mama ..1-59..
verses.translation_reworded: I was never born and I will never die. Nor do I perform any action, good or bad. I am that pure Brahman without attributes. How could there be bondage or liberation for me?

verses.sanskrit:
यदि सर्वगतो देवः स्थिरः पूर्णो निरन्तरः ।
अन्तरं हि न पश्यामि स बाह्याभ्यन्तरः कथम् ॥ १-६०॥
verses.roman:
yadi sarvagato devaḥ sthiraḥ pūrṇo nirantaraḥ .
antaraṃ hi na paśyāmi sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ katham ..1-60..
verses.colloquial:
yadi sarvagato devah sthirah puurno nirantarah .
antaram hi na pashyaami sa baahya abhyantarah katham ..1-60..
verses.translation_reworded: Since Brahman is present everywhere, luminous, motionless, full, and unbroken, I see no diversity at all. How could It be inside or outside?

verses.sanskrit:
स्फुरत्येव जगत्कृत्स्नमखण्डितनिरन्तरम् ।
अहो मायामहामोहो द्वैताद्वैतविकल्पना ॥ १-६१॥
verses.roman:
sphuratyeva jagatkṛtsnamakhaṇḍitanirantaram .
aho māyāmahāmoho dvaitādvaitavikalpanā ..1-61..
verses.colloquial:
sphuraty eva jagat kritsnam akhandita nirantaram |
aho maayaa mahaamoho dvaita advaita vikalpanaa ..1-61..
verses.translation_reworded: To me the entire universe appears as one undivided, unbroken whole. Ah, what a dreadful delusion of maya has produced the split between duality and non-duality!

verses.sanskrit:
साकारं च निराकारं नेति नेतीति सर्वदा ।
भेदाभेदविनिर्मुक्तो वर्तते केवलः शिवः ॥ १-६२॥
verses.roman:
sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ neti netīti sarvadā .
bhedābhedavinirmukto vartate kevalaḥ śivaḥ ..1-62..
verses.colloquial:
saakaaram cha niraakaaram na iti na iti iti sarvadaa |
bheda abheda vinirmukto vartate kevalah shivah ..1-62..
verses.translation_reworded: Every object, whether it has a form or has none, is always denied with the words "Not this, not this." What alone exists is the Supreme Beatitude, free from both difference and sameness.

verses.sanskrit:
न ते च माता च पिता च बन्धुः
न ते च पत्नी न सुतश्च मित्रम् ।
न पक्षपाती न विपक्षपातः
कथं हि सन्तप्तिरियं हि चित्ते ॥ १-६३॥
verses.roman:
na te ca mātā ca pitā ca bandhuḥ
na te ca patnī na sutaśca mitram .
na pakṣapātī na vipakṣapātaḥ
kathaṃ hi santaptiriyaṃ hi citte ..1-63..
verses.colloquial:
na te ca maataa ca pitaa ca bandhuh
na te ca patnii na sutash ca mitram .
na pakshapaatii na vipakshapaatah
katham hi santaptir iyam hi citte ..1-63..
verses.translation_reworded: You have no mother, no father, no relative, no wife, no child, no friend. You have neither favoritism nor indifference. Why, then, is there so much sorrow in your mind?

verses.sanskrit:
दिवा नक्तं न ते चित्तं उदयास्तमयौ न हि ।
विदेहस्य शरीरत्वं कल्पयन्ति कथं बुधाः ॥ १-६४॥
verses.roman:
divā naktaṃ na te cittaṃ udayāstamayau na hi .
videhasya śarīratvaṃ kalpayanti kathaṃ budhāḥ ..1-64..
verses.colloquial:
divaa naktam na te cittam udaya astamayau na hi |
videhasya shariiratvam kalpayanti katham budhaah ..1-64..
verses.translation_reworded: O mind, for you there is no day and no night, no rising and no setting. How could the wise picture a bodiless being as having a body?

verses.sanskrit:
नाविभक्तं विभक्तं च न हि दुःखसुखादि च ।
न हि सर्वमसर्वं च विद्धि चात्मानमव्ययम् ॥ १-६५॥
verses.roman:
nāvibhaktaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca na hi duḥkhasukhādi ca .
na hi sarvamasarvaṃ ca viddhi cātmānamavyayam ..1-65..
verses.colloquial:
na avibhaktam vibhaktam ca na hi duhkha sukha aadi ca |
na hi sarvam asarvam ca viddhi ca aatmaanam avyayam ..1-65..
verses.translation_reworded: Know the unchanging Atman, which is neither the whole nor a part, neither undivided nor divided. It lies beyond both happiness and misery.

verses.sanskrit:
नाहं कर्ता न भोक्ता च न मे कर्म पुराऽधुना ।
न मे देहो विदेहो वा निर्ममेति ममेति किम् ॥ १-६६॥
verses.roman:
nāhaṃ kartā na bhoktā ca na me karma purā'dhunā .
na me deho videho vā nirmameti mameti kim ..1-66..
verses.colloquial:
na aham kartaa na bhoktaa ca na me karma puraa adhunaa |
na me deho videho vaa nirmameti mameti kim ..1-66..
verses.translation_reworded: I am not the one who acts, nor the one who enjoys. In me there is no action, past or present. Since I hold no notion of having a body or of being without one, how could I call it mine or not mine?

verses.sanskrit:
न मे रागादिको दोषो दुःखं देहादिकं न मे ।
आत्मानं विद्धि मामेकं विशालं गगनोपमम् ॥ १-६७॥
verses.roman:
na me rāgādiko doṣo duḥkhaṃ dehādikaṃ na me .
ātmānaṃ viddhi māmekaṃ viśālaṃ gaganopamam ..1-67..
verses.colloquial:
na me raagaadiko dosho duhkham dehaadikam na me .
aatmaanam viddhi maam ekam vishaalam gaganopamam ..1-67..
verses.translation_reworded: I am free of weaknesses such as passion and anger. I am free of the misery that belongs to the body, the mind, and the rest. Know that I am that Atman, one and as vast as space.

verses.sanskrit:
सखे मनः किं बहुजल्पितेन
सखे मनः सर्वमिदं वितर्क्यम् ।
यत्सारभूतं कथितं मया ते
त्वमेव तत्त्वं गगनोपमोऽसि ॥ १-६८॥
verses.roman:
sakhe manaḥ kiṃ bahujalpitena
sakhe manaḥ sarvamidaṃ vitarkyam .
yatsārabhūtaṃ kathitaṃ mayā te
tvameva tattvaṃ gaganopamo'si ..1-68..
verses.colloquial:
sakhe manah kim bahu jalpitena
sakhe manah sarvam idam vitarkyam .
yat saara bhuutam kathitam mayaa te
tvam eva tattvam gagana upamo asi ..1-68..
verses.translation_reworded: My friend the mind, what good is all this empty talk? My friend the mind, all of it is mere speculation. I have told you the essence: you truly are the Reality, limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
येन केनापि भावेन यत्र कुत्र मृता अपि ।
योगिनस्तत्र लीयन्ते घटाकाशमिवाम्बरे ॥ १-६९॥
verses.roman:
yena kenāpi bhāvena yatra kutra mṛtā api .
yoginastatra līyante ghaṭākāśamivāmbare ..1-69..
verses.colloquial:
yena kenaapi bhaavena yatra kutra mritaa api .
yoginas tatra liiyante ghata aakaasham iva ambare ..1-69..
verses.translation_reworded: However and wherever yogis die, they merge into Brahman, just as the space inside a jar joins the boundless space when the jar breaks.

verses.sanskrit:
तीर्थे चान्त्यजगेहे वा नष्टस्मृतिरपि त्यजन् ।
समकाले तनुं मुक्तः कैवल्यव्यापको भवेत् ॥ १-७०॥
verses.roman:
tīrthe cāntyajagehe vā naṣṭasmṛtirapi tyajan .
samakāle tanuṃ muktaḥ kaivalyavyāpako bhavet ..1-70..
verses.colloquial:
tiirthe ca antyaja gehe vaa nashta smriti api tyajan |
sama kaale tanum muktah kaivalya vyaapako bhavet ..1-70..
verses.translation_reworded: A yogi may die at a sacred site or in the home of an outcaste, or even die unconscious; but the moment he leaves the body he becomes one with the Absolute Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षांश्च द्विपदादिचराचरम् ।
मन्यन्ते योगिनः सर्वं मरीचिजलसन्निभम् ॥ १-७१॥
verses.roman:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca dvipadādicarācaram .
manyante yoginaḥ sarvaṃ marīcijalasannibham ..1-71..
verses.colloquial:
dharma artha kaama mokshaamsh cha dvipada aadi chara acharam |
manyante yoginah sarvam mariichi jala sannibham ..1-71..
verses.translation_reworded: To the yogis, everything, duty, wealth, pleasures, liberation, and all things moving and unmoving such as people and trees, is like water in a mirage.

verses.sanskrit:
अतीतानागतं कर्म वर्तमानं तथैव च ।
न करोमि न भुञ्जामि इति मे निश्चला मतिः ॥ १-७२॥
verses.roman:
atītānāgataṃ karma vartamānaṃ tathaiva ca .
na karomi na bhuñjāmi iti me niścalā matiḥ ..1-72..
verses.colloquial:
atiitaanaagatam karma vartamaanam tathaiva ca |
na karomi na bhunjaami iti me nishcalaa matih ..1-72..
verses.translation_reworded: I did not act in the past, I do not act now, and I will not act in the future. Nor did I, do I, or will I enjoy the fruits of such actions. Of this I am firmly convinced.

verses.sanskrit:
शून्यागारे समरसपूत-
स्तिष्ठन्नेकः सुखमवधूतः ।
चरति हि नग्नस्त्यक्त्वा गर्वं
विन्दति केवलमात्मनि सर्वम् ॥ १-७३॥
verses.roman:
śūnyāgāre samarasapūta-
stiṣṭhannekaḥ sukhamavadhūtaḥ .
carati hi nagnastyaktvā garvaṃ
vindati kevalamātmani sarvam ..1-73..
verses.colloquial:
shuunya agaare samarasa puuta
tishthann ekah sukham avadhuutah |
carati hi nagnas tyaktvaa garvam
vindati kevalam aatmani sarvam ..1-73..
verses.translation_reworded: The Avadhuta dwells happily by himself in a solitary place, cleansed by the unbroken bliss of Brahman. Having given up the ego, the wandering Avadhuta roams about and finds everything within his own Self.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रितयतुरीयं न हि नहि यत्र
विन्दति केवलमात्मनि तत्र ।
धर्माधर्मौ न हि नहि यत्र
बद्धो मुक्तः कथमिह तत्र ॥ १-७४॥
verses.roman:
tritayaturīyaṃ na hi nahi yatra
vindati kevalamātmani tatra .
dharmādharmau na hi nahi yatra
baddho muktaḥ kathamiha tatra ..1-74..
verses.colloquial:
tritaya turiiyam na hi nahi yatra
vindati kevalam aatmani tatra |
dharma adharmau na hi nahi yatra
baddho muktah katham iha tatra ..1-74..
verses.translation_reworded: Where there is no threefold state and not even the Fourth (the Transcendental), there one reaches the Absolute Atman. Where there is neither virtue nor vice, how could bondage or liberation exist?

verses.sanskrit:
विन्दति विन्दति न हि नहि मन्त्रं
छन्दोलक्षणं न हि नहि तन्त्रम् ।
समरसमग्नो भावितपूतः
प्रलपितमेतत्परमवधूतः ॥ १-७५॥
verses.roman:
vindati vindati na hi nahi mantraṃ
chandolakṣaṇaṃ na hi nahi tantram .
samarasamagno bhāvitapūtaḥ
pralapitametatparamavadhūtaḥ ..1-75..
verses.colloquial:
vindati vindati na hi nahi mantram
chando lakshanam na hi nahi tantram .
samarasa magno bhaavita puutah
pralapitam etat parama avadhuutah ..1-75..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman cannot be reached by repeating mantras, reciting the Vedas, or performing tantric rites. The great Avadhuta, having purified himself through meditation and become absorbed in the unbroken bliss of Brahman, sang this Gita spontaneously.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वशून्यमशून्यं च सत्यासत्यं न विद्यते ।
स्वभावभावतः प्रोक्तं शास्त्रसंवित्तिपूर्वकम् ॥ १-७६॥
verses.roman:
sarvaśūnyamaśūnyaṃ ca satyāsatyaṃ na vidyate .
svabhāvabhāvataḥ proktaṃ śāstrasaṃvittipūrvakam ..1-76..
verses.colloquial:
sarva shuunyam ashuunyam ca satya asatyam na vidyate |
svabhaava bhaavatah proktam shaastra samvitti puurvakam ..1-76..
verses.translation_reworded: Everything is empty and at the same time full. In Brahman there is neither truth nor falsehood. The Avadhuta declares this from his own experience and also from his knowledge of the scriptures.

verses.sanskrit:
<vt>अथ द्वितीयोऽध्यायः</vt>
बालस्य वा विषयभोगरतस्य वापि
मूर्खस्य सेवकजनस्य गृहस्थितस्य ।
एतद्गुरोः किमपि नैव न चिन्तनीयं
रत्नं कथं त्यजति कोऽप्यशुचौ प्रविष्टम् ॥ २-१॥
verses.roman:
<vt>Chapter 2</vt>
bālasya vā viṣayabhogaratasya vāpi
mūrkhasya sevakajanasya gṛhasthitasya .
etadguroḥ kimapi naiva na cintanīyaṃ
ratnaṃ kathaṃ tyajati ko'pyaśucau praviṣṭam ..2-1..
verses.colloquial:
<vt>Chapter 2</vt>
baalasya vaa vishaya bhoga ratasya vaapi
muurkhasya sevaka janasya griha sthitasya .
etad guroh kim api naiva na cintaniiyam
ratnam katham tyajati ko api ashucau pravishtam ..2-1..
verses.translation_reworded: A guru may be young, or someone who enjoys worldly pleasures; he may be unlettered, a servant, or a householder. None of this should count. Does anyone throw away a gem because it fell in the dirt?

verses.sanskrit:
नैवात्र काव्यगुण एव तु चिन्तनीयो
ग्राह्यः परं गुणवता खलु सार एव ।
सिन्दूरचित्ररहिता भुवि रूपशून्या
पारं न किं नयति नौरिह गन्तुकामान् ॥ २-२॥
verses.roman:
naivātra kāvyaguṇa eva tu cintanīyo
grāhyaḥ paraṃ guṇavatā khalu sāra eva .
sindūracitrarahitā bhuvi rūpaśūnyā
pāraṃ na kiṃ nayati nauriha gantukāmān ..2-2..
verses.colloquial:
naiva atra kaavya guna eva tu cintaniiyo
graahyah param gunavataa khalu saara eva .
sinduura citra rahitaa bhuvi ruupa shuunyaa
paaram na kim nayati naur iha gantu kaamaan ..2-2..
verses.translation_reworded: A guru's teaching should not be judged by its literary quality. Intelligent people take the essence. Can a boat not carry passengers across the ocean even if it is unpainted and ugly?

verses.sanskrit:
प्रयत्नेन विना येन निश्चलेन चलाचलम् ।
ग्रस्तं स्वभावतः शान्तं चैतन्यं गगनोपमम् ॥ २-३॥
verses.roman:
prayatnena vinā yena niścalena calācalam .
grastaṃ svabhāvataḥ śāntaṃ caitanyaṃ gaganopamam ..2-3..
verses.colloquial:
prayatnena vinaa yena nishcalena calaacalam |
grastam svabhaavatah shaantam caitanyam gagana upamam ..2-3..
verses.translation_reworded: The motionless Brahman holds everything that moves and everything that does not, without any effort. By nature It is calm, conscious, and all-pervading like space.

verses.sanskrit:
अयत्नाछालयेद्यस्तु एकमेव चराचरम् ।
सर्वगं तत्कथं भिन्नमद्वैतं वर्तते मम ॥ २-४॥
verses.roman:
ayatnāchālayedyastu ekameva carācaram .
sarvagaṃ tatkathaṃ bhinnamadvaitaṃ vartate mama ..2-4..
verses.colloquial:
ayatnaat chaalayed yas tu ekam eva cara acaram |
sarvagam tat katham bhinnam advaitam vartate mama ..2-4..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly, that all-present Brahman alone directs, without effort, all that moves and all that stands still. How, then, could that non-dual Brahman be different from me?

verses.sanskrit:
अहमेव परं यस्मात्सारात्सारतरं शिवम् ।
गमागमविनिर्मुक्तं निर्विकल्पं निराकुलम् ॥ २-५॥
verses.roman:
ahameva paraṃ yasmātsārātsārataraṃ śivam .
gamāgamavinirmuktaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirākulam ..2-5..
verses.colloquial:
aham eva param yasmaat saaraat saarataram shivam |
gama aagama vinirmuktam nirvikalpam niraakulam ..2-5..
verses.translation_reworded: Because I am that Supreme Beatitude, I am beyond what is essential and what is not. I am free from birth and death, from doubt and confusion.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वावयवनिर्मुक्तं तथाहं त्रिदशार्चितम् ।
सम्पूर्णत्वान्न गृह्णामि विभागं त्रिदशादिकम् ॥ २-६॥
verses.roman:
sarvāvayavanirmuktaṃ tathāhaṃ tridaśārcitam .
sampūrṇatvānna gṛhṇāmi vibhāgaṃ tridaśādikam ..2-6..
verses.colloquial:
sarva avayava nirmuktam tathaa aham tridasha arcitam |
sampuurnatvaan na grihnaami vibhaagam tridasha aadikam ..2-6..
verses.translation_reworded: Having no constituent parts, I am worshipped by the gods. Since I am that undivided Being, I recognize no distinctions among the gods (such as Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva).

verses.sanskrit:
प्रमादेन न सन्देहः किं करिष्यामि वृत्तिमान् ।
उत्पद्यन्ते विलीयन्ते बुद्बुदाश्च यथा जले ॥ २-७॥
verses.roman:
pramādena na sandehaḥ kiṃ kariṣyāmi vṛttimān .
utpadyante vilīyante budbudāśca yathā jale ..2-7..
verses.colloquial:
pramaadena na sandehah kim karishyaami vrittimaan |
utpadyante viliiyante budbudaash ca yathaa jale ..2-7..
verses.translation_reworded: Ignorance cannot raise any doubt in me. Why should I be concerned with the waves of the mind? They rise and vanish like bubbles on water.

verses.sanskrit:
महदादीनि भूतानि समाप्यैवं सदैव हि ।
मृदुद्रव्येषु तीक्ष्णेषु गुडेषु कटुकेषु च ॥ २-८॥
verses.roman:
mahadādīni bhūtāni samāpyaivaṃ sadaiva hi .
mṛdudravyeṣu tīkṣṇeṣu guḍeṣu kaṭukeṣu ca ..2-8..
verses.colloquial:
mahad aadiini bhuutaani samaapyaivam sadaiva hi .
mridu dravyeshu tiikshneshu gudeshu katukeshu ca ..2-8..
verses.translation_reworded: Just as softness, hardness, sweetness, and bitterness are always bound to the things that have them, so cosmic intelligence and the other elements are always pervaded by Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
कटुत्वं चैव शैत्यत्वं मृदुत्वं च यथा जले ।
प्रकृतिः पुरुषस्तद्वदभिन्नं प्रतिभाति मे ॥ २-९॥
verses.roman:
kaṭutvaṃ caiva śaityatvaṃ mṛdutvaṃ ca yathā jale .
prakṛtiḥ puruṣastadvadabhinnaṃ pratibhāti me ..2-9..
verses.colloquial:
katutvam caiva shaityatvam mridutvam ca yathaa jale .
prakriti purushas tadvad abhinnam pratibhaati me ..2-9..
verses.translation_reworded: Just as water may be hot, cold, or lukewarm and still remain water, so, it seems to me, prakriti (matter) and Purusha (Spirit) are one and the same.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वाख्यारहितं यद्यत्सूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतरं परम् ।
मनोबुद्धीन्द्रियातीतमकलङ्कं जगत्पतिम् ॥ २-१०॥
verses.roman:
sarvākhyārahitaṃ yadyatsūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ param .
manobuddhīndriyātītamakalaṅkaṃ jagatpatim ..2-10..
verses.colloquial:
sarva aakhyaa rahitam yad yat suukshmaat suukshmataram param |
mano buddhi indriya atiitam akalankam jagat patim ..2-10..
verses.translation_reworded: Because Brahman is finer than the finest, It has no name. It is beyond the senses, the mind, and the intellect. It is the ever-radiant Lord of the universe.

verses.sanskrit:
ईदृशं सहजं यत्र अहं तत्र कथं भवेत् ।
त्वमेव हि कथं तत्र कथं तत्र चराचरम् ॥ २-११॥
verses.roman:
īdṛśaṃ sahajaṃ yatra ahaṃ tatra kathaṃ bhavet .
tvameva hi kathaṃ tatra kathaṃ tatra carācaram ..2-11..
verses.colloquial:
iidrisham sahajam yatra aham tatra katham bhavet |
tvam eva hi katham tatra katham tatra cara acaram ..2-11..
verses.translation_reworded: When Brahman is such a self-existent reality, how can there be an "I" or a "you," or this universe of moving and unmoving things?

verses.sanskrit:
गगनोपमं तु यत्प्रोक्तं तदेव गगनोपमम् ।
चैतन्यं दोषहीनं च सर्वज्ञं पूर्णमेव च ॥ २-१२॥
verses.roman:
gaganopamaṃ tu yatproktaṃ tadeva gaganopamam .
caitanyaṃ doṣahīnaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ pūrṇameva ca ..2-12..
verses.colloquial:
gagana upamam tu yat proktam tad eva gagana upamam .
caitanyam dosha hiinam ca sarvajnam puurnam eva ca ..2-12..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman has been likened to space, and indeed, like space, It pervades everything. Brahman is pure consciousness, all-knowing, and complete.

verses.sanskrit:
पृथिव्यां चरितं नैव मारुतेन च वाहितम् ।
वरिणा पिहितं नैव तेजोमध्ये व्यवस्थितम् ॥ २-१३॥
verses.roman:
pṛthivyāṃ caritaṃ naiva mārutena ca vāhitam .
variṇā pihitaṃ naiva tejomadhye vyavasthitam ..2-13..
verses.colloquial:
prithivyaam caritam naiva maarutena ca vaahitam |
varinaa pihitam naiva tejo madhye vyavasthitam ..2-13..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly, Brahman does not walk upon the earth, nor is It borne by the wind; It is not sunk in water, nor does It live in fire.

verses.sanskrit:
आकाशं तेन संव्याप्तं न तद्व्याप्तं च केनचित् ।
स बाह्याभ्यन्तरं तिष्ठत्यवच्छिन्नं निरन्तरम् ॥ २-१४॥
verses.roman:
ākāśaṃ tena saṃvyāptaṃ na tadvyāptaṃ ca kenacit .
sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ tiṣṭhatyavacchinnaṃ nirantaram ..2-14..
verses.colloquial:
aakaasham tena samvyaaptam na tad vyaaptam ca kenacit .
sa baahya abhyantaram tishthaty avacchinnam nirantaram ..2-14..
verses.translation_reworded: Space is wholly pervaded by Brahman, yet nothing pervades Brahman. It dwells within and without, undivided and unbroken.

verses.sanskrit:
सूक्ष्मत्वात्तददृश्यत्वान्निर्गुणत्वाच्च योगिभिः ।
आलम्बनादि यत्प्रोक्तं क्रमादालम्बनं भवेत् ॥ २-१५॥
verses.roman:
sūkṣmatvāttadadṛśyatvānnirguṇatvācca yogibhiḥ .
ālambanādi yatproktaṃ kramādālambanaṃ bhavet ..2-15..
verses.colloquial:
suukshmatvaat tad adrishyatvaan nirgunatvaac ca yogibhih |
aalambanaadi yat proktam kramaad aalambanam bhavet ..2-15..
verses.translation_reworded: Since Brahman is subtle, unseen, and without qualities, whatever methods the yogis have laid down for realizing It should be followed, step by step.

verses.sanskrit:
सतताऽभ्यासयुक्तस्तु निरालम्बो यदा भवेत् ।
तल्लयाल्लीयते नान्तर्गुणदोषविवर्जितः ॥ २-१६॥
verses.roman:
satatā'bhyāsayuktastu nirālambo yadā bhavet .
tallayāllīyate nāntarguṇadoṣavivarjitaḥ ..2-16..
verses.colloquial:
satataa abhyaasa yuktas tu niraalambo yadaa bhavet |
tallayaal liiyate na antar guna dosha vivarjitah ..2-16..
verses.translation_reworded: Through steady practice of yoga the mind stops clinging to any object; and when objects fall away, the mind dissolves into the Final Cause, leaving good and evil behind.

verses.sanskrit:
विषविश्वस्य रौद्रस्य मोहमूर्च्छाप्रदस्य च ।
एकमेव विनाशाय ह्यमोघं सहजामृतम् ॥ २-१७॥
verses.roman:
viṣaviśvasya raudrasya mohamūrcchāpradasya ca .
ekameva vināśāya hyamoghaṃ sahajāmṛtam ..2-17..
verses.colloquial:
visha vishvasya raudrasya moha muurcchaa pradasya ca |
ekam eva vinaashaaya hi amogham sahaja amritam ..2-17..
verses.translation_reworded: For the deadly poison of worldliness, which brings on the stupor of delusion, there is only one unfailing remedy: the ambrosia of Brahman that is one's own nature.

verses.sanskrit:
भावगम्यं निराकारं साकारं दृष्टिगोचरम् ।
भावाभावविनिर्मुक्तमन्तरालं तदुच्यते ॥ २-१८॥
verses.roman:
bhāvagamyaṃ nirākāraṃ sākāraṃ dṛṣṭigocaram .
bhāvābhāvavinirmuktamantarālaṃ taducyate ..2-18..
verses.colloquial:
bhaava gamyam niraakaaram saakaaram drishti gocaram |
bhaava abhaava vinirmuktam antaraalam tad ucyate ..2-18..
verses.translation_reworded: The formless can be thought of, and a form can be pictured. But Brahman is neither being nor non-being. It may be called the Innermost One.

verses.sanskrit:
बाह्यभावं भवेद्विश्वमन्तः प्रकृतिरुच्यते ।
अन्तरादन्तरं ज्ञेयं नारिकेलफलाम्बुवत् ॥ २-१९॥
verses.roman:
bāhyabhāvaṃ bhavedviśvamantaḥ prakṛtirucyate .
antarādantaraṃ jñeyaṃ nārikelaphalāmbuvat ..2-19..
verses.colloquial:
baahya bhaavam bhaved vishvam antah prakritir ucyate |
antaraad antaram jneyam naarikela phala ambuvat ..2-19..
verses.translation_reworded: The outer expression is this universe; the inner expression is called prakriti, or maya. Realize Brahman, which is said to be the innermost of the inner, like the water (milk) inside the kernel of a coconut.

verses.sanskrit:
भ्रान्तिज्ञानं स्थितं बाह्यं सम्यग्ज्ञानं च मध्यगम् ।
मध्यान्मध्यतरं ज्ञेयं नारिकेलफलाम्बुवत् ॥ २-२०॥
verses.roman:
bhrāntijñānaṃ sthitaṃ bāhyaṃ samyagjñānaṃ ca madhyagam .
madhyānmadhyataraṃ jñeyaṃ nārikelaphalāmbuvat ..2-20..
verses.colloquial:
bhraanti jnaanam sthitam baahyam samyag jnaanam ca madhyagam |
madhyaan madhyataram jneyam naarikela phala ambuvat ..2-20..
verses.translation_reworded: Knowledge concerned with the outer world is false. True knowledge arises within (in the pure mind). Realize Brahman, the innermost of the inner self, like the water (milk) inside the kernel of a coconut.

verses.sanskrit:
पौर्णमास्यां यथा चन्द्र एक एवातिनिर्मलः ।
तेन तत्सदृशं पश्येद्द्विधादृष्टिर्विपर्ययः ॥ २-२१॥
verses.roman:
paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā candra eka evātinirmalaḥ .
tena tatsadṛśaṃ paśyeddvidhādṛṣṭirviparyayaḥ ..2-21..
verses.colloquial:
paurnamaasyaam yathaa candra eka eva ati nirmalah |
tena tat sadrisham pashyed dvidhaa drishtir viparyayah ..2-21..
verses.translation_reworded: Just as on a full-moon night one sees the moon as single and brilliant, so one should see Brahman as one and radiant. Seeing duality arises from mistaken perception.

verses.sanskrit:
अनेनैव प्रकारेण बुद्धिभेदो न सर्वगः ।
दाता च धीरतामेति गीयते नामकोटिभिः ॥ २-२२॥
verses.roman:
anenaiva prakāreṇa buddhibhedo na sarvagaḥ .
dātā ca dhīratāmeti gīyate nāmakoṭibhiḥ ..2-22..
verses.colloquial:
anenaiva prakaarena buddhi bhedo na sarvagah |
daataa cha dhiirataam eti giiyate naama kotibhih ..2-22..
verses.translation_reworded: (Since dualistic vision comes from mistaken perception,) a person of scattered intellect cannot realize the all-present Brahman. Only the pure reach the tranquil state of Brahman, and such a person's name is praised by many.

verses.sanskrit:
गुरुप्रज्ञाप्रसादेन मूर्खो वा यदि पण्डितः ।
यस्तु सम्बुध्यते तत्त्वं विरक्तो भवसागरात् ॥ २-२३॥
verses.roman:
guruprajñāprasādena mūrkho vā yadi paṇḍitaḥ .
yastu sambudhyate tattvaṃ virakto bhavasāgarāt ..2-23..
verses.colloquial:
guru prajnaa prasaadena muurkho vaa yadi panditah |
yas tu sambudhyate tattvam virakto bhava saagaraat ..2-23..
verses.translation_reworded: Whether learned or unlettered, anyone who realizes that Truth through the grace of the guru and the grace of his own intellect is set free from the stormy ocean of maya.

verses.sanskrit:
रागद्वेषविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वभूतहिते रतः ।
दृढबोधश्च धीरश्च स गच्छेत्परमं पदम् ॥ २-२४॥
verses.roman:
rāgadveṣavinirmuktaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ .
dṛḍhabodhaśca dhīraśca sa gacchetparamaṃ padam ..2-24..
verses.colloquial:
raaga dvesha vinirmukta sarva bhuuta hite ratah .
dridha bodhash cha dhiirash cha sa gacchet paramam padam ..2-24..
verses.translation_reworded: One who reaches the Supreme Reality is free of attachment and aversion, devoted to the good of all beings, serene, and steady in intellect.

verses.sanskrit:
घटे भिन्ने घटाकाश आकाशे लीयते यथा ।
देहाभावे तथा योगी स्वरूपे परमात्मनि ॥ २-२५॥
verses.roman:
ghaṭe bhinne ghaṭākāśa ākāśe līyate yathā .
dehābhāve tathā yogī svarūpe paramātmani ..2-25..
verses.colloquial:
ghate bhinne ghataakaasha aakaashe liiyate yathaa .
deha abhaave tathaa yogii svaruupe paramaatmani ..2-25..
verses.translation_reworded: Just as the space in a jar becomes one with cosmic space when the jar is destroyed, so the yogi, after death, merges into his true nature, the Supreme Self.

verses.sanskrit:
उक्तेयं कर्मयुक्तानां मतिर्यान्तेऽपि सा गतिः ।
न चोक्ता योगयुक्तानां मतिर्यान्तेऽपि सा गतिः ॥ २-२६॥
verses.roman:
ukteyaṃ karmayuktānāṃ matiryānte'pi sā gatiḥ .
na coktā yogayuktānāṃ matiryānte'pi sā gatiḥ ..2-26..
verses.colloquial:
ukteyam karma yuktaanaam matir yaante api saa gatih |
na coktaa yoga yuktaanaam matir yaante api saa gatih ..2-26..
verses.translation_reworded: Of those who follow the path of action it is said that they attain whatever state they long for at the moment of death. But this has not been said of those who follow yoga.

verses.sanskrit:
या गतिः कर्मयुक्तानां सा च वागिन्द्रियाद्वदेत् ।
योगिनां या गतिः क्वापि ह्यकथ्या भवतोर्जिता ॥ २-२७॥
verses.roman:
yā gatiḥ karmayuktānāṃ sā ca vāgindriyādvadet .
yogināṃ yā gatiḥ kvāpi hyakathyā bhavatorjitā ..2-27..
verses.colloquial:
yaa gatih karma yuktaanaam saa ca vaag indriyaad vadet |
yoginaam yaa gatih kvaapi hy akathyaa bhavator jitaa ..2-27..
verses.translation_reworded: The destination of those who follow action can be put into words; but the goal of the yogis cannot be expressed, because it is not something to be acquired.

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ज्ञात्वा त्वमुं मार्गं योगिनां नैव कल्पितम् ।
विकल्पवर्जनं तेषां स्वयं सिद्धिः प्रवर्तते ॥ २-२८॥
verses.roman:
evaṃ jñātvā tvamuṃ mārgaṃ yogināṃ naiva kalpitam .
vikalpavarjanaṃ teṣāṃ svayaṃ siddhiḥ pravartate ..2-28..
verses.colloquial:
evam jnaatvaa tvam um maargam yoginaam naiva kalpitam .
vikalpa varjanam teshaam svayam siddhih pravartate ..2-28..
verses.translation_reworded: Knowing this, one should not imagine any particular path for the yogis. They abandon desire and doubt, and so their perfection comes about of itself.

verses.sanskrit:
तीर्थे वान्त्यजगेहे वा यत्र कुत्र मृतोऽपि वा ।
न योगी पश्यते गर्भं परे ब्रह्मणि लीयते ॥ २-२९॥
verses.roman:
tīrthe vāntyajagehe vā yatra kutra mṛto'pi vā .
na yogī paśyate garbhaṃ pare brahmaṇi līyate ..2-29..
verses.colloquial:
tiirthe va antyaja gehe vaa yatra kutra mrito api vaa .
na yogii pashyate garbham pare brahmani liiyate ..2-29..
verses.translation_reworded: Wherever a yogi dies, whether in a holy place or in the home of an outcaste, he never again enters a mother's womb. He merges into Supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
सहजमजमचिन्त्यं यस्तु पश्येत्स्वरूपं
घटति यदि यथेष्टं लिप्यते नैव दोषैः ।
सकृदपि तदभावात्कर्म किञ्चिन्नकुर्यात्
तदपि न च विबद्धः संयमी वा तपस्वी ॥ २-३०॥
verses.roman:
sahajamajamacintyaṃ yastu paśyetsvarūpaṃ
ghaṭati yadi yatheṣṭaṃ lipyate naiva doṣaiḥ .
sakṛdapi tadabhāvātkarma kiñcinnakuryāt
tadapi na ca vibaddhaḥ saṃyamī vā tapasvī ..2-30..
verses.colloquial:
sahajam ajam acintyam yas tu pashyet svaruupam
ghatati yadi yatheshtam lipyate naiva doshaih |
sakrid api tad abhaavaat karma kincin na kuryaat
tad api na ca vibaddhah samyamii vaa tapasvii ..2-30..
verses.translation_reworded: One who has realized the Self, which is innate, unborn, and beyond conception, is not stained by any evil, however he may act. And once free from ignorance, he can perform no action at all. For this reason the self-controlled mendicant is never bound. (Bhagavad Gita 5.10)

verses.sanskrit:
निरामयं निष्प्रतिमं निराकृतिं
निराश्रयं निर्वपुषं निराशिषम् ।
निर्द्वन्द्वनिर्मोहमलुप्तशक्तिकं
तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥ २-३१॥
verses.roman:
nirāmayaṃ niṣpratimaṃ nirākṛtiṃ
nirāśrayaṃ nirvapuṣaṃ nirāśiṣam .
nirdvandvanirmohamaluptaśaktikaṃ
tamīśamātmānamupaiti śāśvatam ..2-31..
verses.colloquial:
niraamayam nishpratimam niraakritim
niraashrayam nirvapusham niraashisham .
nirdvandva nirmoham alupta shaktikam
tam iisham aatmaanam upaiti shaashvatam ..2-31..
verses.translation_reworded: The yogi reaches that eternal Supreme Atman, which is pure, without equal, formless, without support, without body, without desire, beyond the pairs of opposites, free of delusion, and undiminished in power.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदो न दीक्षा न च मुण्डनक्रिया
गुरुर्न शिष्यो न च यन्त्रसम्पदः ।
मुद्रादिकं चापि न यत्र भासते
तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥ २-३२॥
verses.roman:
vedo na dīkṣā na ca muṇḍanakriyā
gururna śiṣyo na ca yantrasampadaḥ .
mudrādikaṃ cāpi na yatra bhāsate
tamīśamātmānamupaiti śāśvatam ..2-32..
verses.colloquial:
vedo na diikshaa na ca mundana kriyaa
gurur na shishyo na ca yantra sampadah .
mudraa aadikam ca api na yatra bhaasate
tam iisham aatmaanam upaiti shaashvatam ..2-32..
verses.translation_reworded: The yogi reaches that eternal Supreme Atman, which neither the Vedas, nor initiation, nor shaving of the head, nor guru, nor disciple, nor symbolic diagrams, nor mudras (hand gestures) can bring to light.

verses.sanskrit:
न शाम्भवं शाक्तिकमानवं न वा
पिण्डं च रूपं च पदादिकं न वा ।
आरम्भनिष्पत्तिघटादिकं च नो
तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥ २-३३॥
verses.roman:
na śāmbhavaṃ śāktikamānavaṃ na vā
piṇḍaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca padādikaṃ na vā .
ārambhaniṣpattighaṭādikaṃ ca no
tamīśamātmānamupaiti śāśvatam ..2-33..
verses.colloquial:
na shaambhavam shaaktikam aanavam na vaa
pindam cha ruupam cha pada aadikam na vaa .
aarambha nishpatti ghata aadikam cha no
tam iisham aatmaanam upaiti shaashvatam ..2-33..
verses.translation_reworded: The yogi reaches that eternal Supreme Atman, which did not arise from Shiva, Shakti, or Manu. It is not a lump of flesh; It has no form and no limbs such as feet or hands. It is not a thing like a jar, which can be shaped and completed.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य स्वरूपात्सचराचरं जग-
दुत्पद्यते तिष्ठति लीयतेऽपि वा ।
पयोविकारादिव फेनबुद्बुदा-
स्तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥ २-३४॥
verses.roman:
yasya svarūpātsacarācaraṃ jaga-
dutpadyate tiṣṭhati līyate'pi vā .
payovikārādiva phenabudbudā-
stamīśamātmānamupaiti śāśvatam ..2-34..
verses.colloquial:
yasya svaruupaat sa cara acaram jagad
utpadyate tishthati liiyate api vaa .
payo vikaaraad iva phena budbudaas
tam iisham aatmaanam upaiti shaashvatam ..2-34..
verses.translation_reworded: The yogi reaches that eternal Supreme Atman, from whose essence both the moving and the unmoving worlds arise, in which they rest, and into which they dissolve again, just as foam and bubbles form from changes in water and then sink back into it.

verses.sanskrit:
नासानिरोधो न च दृष्टिरासनं
बोधोऽप्यबोधोऽपि न यत्र भासते ।
नाडीप्रचारोऽपि न यत्र किञ्चि-
त्तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥ २-३५॥
verses.roman:
nāsānirodho na ca dṛṣṭirāsanaṃ
bodho'pyabodho'pi na yatra bhāsate .
nāḍīpracāro'pi na yatra kiñci-
ttamīśamātmānamupaiti śāśvatam ..2-35..
verses.colloquial:
naasaa nirodho na ca drishtir aasanam
bodho api abodho api na yatra bhaasate .
naadii pracaaro api na yatra kincit
tam iisham aatmaanam upaiti shaashvatam ..2-35..
verses.translation_reworded: The yogi reaches that eternal Supreme Atman, which is beyond knowledge and ignorance, and which is not revealed by disciplines such as controlling the breath, fixing the gaze, practicing postures, or working the nerve-currents (that is, the movement of the ida, pingala, and sushumna).

verses.sanskrit:
नानात्वमेकत्वमुभत्वमन्यता
अणुत्वदीर्घत्वमहत्त्वशून्यता ।
मानत्वमेयत्वसमत्ववर्जितं
तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥ २-३६॥
verses.roman:
nānātvamekatvamubhatvamanyatā
aṇutvadīrghatvamahattvaśūnyatā .
mānatvameyatvasamatvavarjitaṃ
tamīśamātmānamupaiti śāśvatam ..2-36..
verses.colloquial:
naanaatvam ekatvam ubhatvam anyataa
anutva diirghatva mahattva shuunyataa .
maanatvam eyatva samatva varjitam
tam iisham aatmaanam upaiti shaashvatam ..2-36..
verses.translation_reworded: The yogi reaches that eternal Supreme Atman, which is neither many nor one, neither both nor something else. It is free of smallness, largeness, vastness, and emptiness. It has no measure, no dimension, and no sameness.

verses.sanskrit:
सुसंयमी वा यदि वा न संयमी
सुसङ्ग्रही वा यदि वा न सङ्ग्रही ।
निष्कर्मको वा यदि वा सकर्मक-
स्तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥ २-३७॥
verses.roman:
susaṃyamī vā yadi vā na saṃyamī
susaṅgrahī vā yadi vā na saṅgrahī .
niṣkarmako vā yadi vā sakarmaka-
stamīśamātmānamupaiti śāśvatam ..2-37..
verses.colloquial:
susamyamii vaa yadi vaa na samyamii
susangrahii vaa yadi vaa na sangrahii .
nishkarmako vaa yadi vaa sakarmaka
stam iisham aatmaanam upaiti shaashvatam ..2-37..
verses.translation_reworded: The yogi reaches that eternal Supreme Atman, whether or not he is a self-restrained ascetic, whether or not he owns great wealth, whether he is active or inactive.

verses.sanskrit:
मनो न बुद्धिर्न शरीरमिन्द्रियं
तन्मात्रभूतानि न भूतपञ्चकम् ।
अहङ्कृतिश्चापि वियत्स्वरूपकं
तमीशमात्मानमुपैति शाश्वतम् ॥ २-३८॥
verses.roman:
mano na buddhirna śarīramindriyaṃ
tanmātrabhūtāni na bhūtapañcakam .
ahaṅkṛtiścāpi viyatsvarūpakaṃ
tamīśamātmānamupaiti śāśvatam ..2-38..
verses.colloquial:
mano na buddhir na shariiram indriyam
tan maatra bhuutaani na bhuuta pancakam .
ahankritish cha api viyat svaruupakam
tam iisham aatmaanam upaiti shaashvatam ..2-38..
verses.translation_reworded: The yogi reaches that eternal Supreme Atman, which is not the body, the senses, the mind, the intellect, or the ego. Nor is It the five subtle elements, the five gross elements, or anything of the nature of space.

verses.sanskrit:
विधौ निरोधे परमात्मतां गते
न योगिनश्चेतसि भेदवर्जिते ।
शौचं न वाशौचमलिङ्गभावना
सर्वं विधेयं यदि वा निषिध्यते ॥ २-३९॥
verses.roman:
vidhau nirodhe paramātmatāṃ gate
na yoginaścetasi bhedavarjite .
śaucaṃ na vāśaucamaliṅgabhāvanā
sarvaṃ vidheyaṃ yadi vā niṣidhyate ..2-39..
verses.colloquial:
vidhau nirodhe paramaatmataam gate
na yoginash cetasi bheda varjite |
shaucam na vaa shaucam alinga bhaavanaa
sarvam vidheyam yadi vaa nishidhyate ..2-39..
verses.translation_reworded: When the yogi reaches that Supreme Atman, he passes beyond the commands and prohibitions of the scriptures. In the undifferentiated mind of such a yogi there is no notion of purity or impurity, nor can any evil thought arise. What is forbidden to others is permitted to him, because he stands beyond all rules.

verses.sanskrit:
मनो वचो यत्र न शक्तमीरितुं
नूनं कथं तत्र गुरूपदेशता ।
इमां कथामुक्तवतो गुरोस्त-
द्युक्तस्य तत्त्वं हि समं प्रकाशते ॥ २-४०॥
verses.roman:
mano vaco yatra na śaktamīrituṃ
nūnaṃ kathaṃ tatra gurūpadeśatā .
imāṃ kathāmuktavato gurosta-
dyuktasya tattvaṃ hi samaṃ prakāśate ..2-40..
verses.colloquial:
mano vaco yatra na shaktam iiritum
nuunam katham tatra guru upadeshataa .
imaam kathaam uktavato gurost a
dyuktasya tattvam hi samam prakaashate ..2-40..
verses.translation_reworded: The mind cannot grasp Brahman, and speech cannot express It, let alone the instruction of a guru. Yet Brahman is fully revealed to one who has absorbed the instruction of the guru who proclaimed that Truth.

verses.sanskrit:
<vt>अथ तृतीयोऽध्यायः</vt>
गुणविगुणविभागो वर्तते नैव किञ्चित्
रतिविरतिविहीनं निर्मलं निष्प्रपञ्चम् ।
गुणविगुणविहीनं व्यापकं विश्वरूपं
कथमहमिह वन्दे व्योमरूपं शिवं वै ॥ ३-१॥
verses.roman:
<vt>Chapter 3</vt>
guṇaviguṇavibhāgo vartate naiva kiñcit
rativirativihīnaṃ nirmalaṃ niṣprapañcam .
guṇaviguṇavihīnaṃ vyāpakaṃ viśvarūpaṃ
kathamahamiha vande vyomarūpaṃ śivaṃ vai ..3-1..
verses.colloquial:
<vt>Chapter 3</vt>
guna viguna vibhaago vartate naiva kincit
rati virati vihiinam nirmalam nishprapancam .
guna viguna vihiinam vyaapakam vishvaruupam
katham aham iha vande vyomaruupam shivam vai ..3-1..
verses.translation_reworded: In Brahman the division into merit and demerit is entirely absent. Brahman is pure, unmanifest, and free from both passion and dispassion. How can I worship that infinite Supreme Beatitude, which is neither with attributes nor without them, and which pervades and is present everywhere?

verses.sanskrit:
श्वेतादिवर्णरहितो नियतं शिवश्च
कार्यं हि कारणमिदं हि परं शिवश्च ।
एवं विकल्परहितोऽहमलं शिवश्च
स्वात्मानमात्मनि सुमित्र कथं नमामि ॥ ३-२॥
verses.roman:
śvetādivarṇarahito niyataṃ śivaśca
kāryaṃ hi kāraṇamidaṃ hi paraṃ śivaśca .
evaṃ vikalparahito'hamalaṃ śivaśca
svātmānamātmani sumitra kathaṃ namāmi ..3-2..
verses.colloquial:
shvetaadi varna rahito niyatam shivashca
kaaryam hi kaaranam idam hi param shivashca .
evam vikalpa rahito aham alam shivashca
svaatmaanam aatmani sumitra katham namaami ..3-2..
verses.translation_reworded: The Supreme Beatitude is eternal and free of colors such as white, red, and black. Truly It is both cause and effect. I am indeed that Brahman, free from all diversity. O dear friend, how can I, the Self, bow to the Self?

verses.sanskrit:
निर्मूलमूलरहितो हि सदोदितोऽहं
निर्धूमधूमरहितो हि सदोदितोऽहम् ।
निर्दीपदीपरहितो हि सदोदितोऽहं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३॥
verses.roman:
nirmūlamūlarahito hi sadodito'haṃ
nirdhūmadhūmarahito hi sadodito'ham .
nirdīpadīparahito hi sadodito'haṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-3..
verses.colloquial:
nir muula muula rahito hi sadodito aham
nir dhuuma dhuuma rahito hi sadodito aham .
nir diipa diipa rahito hi sadodito aham
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-3..
verses.translation_reworded: I am uncreated and apart from creation, for I am always present. I am unclouded and free of the cloud of maya, for I am always manifest. I borrow no light from any other light, and I am also apart from luminous things, for I shine by myself. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निष्कामकाममिह नाम कथं वदामि
निःसङ्गसङ्गमिह नाम कथं वदामि ।
निःसारसाररहितं च कथं वदामि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-४॥
verses.roman:
niṣkāmakāmamiha nāma kathaṃ vadāmi
niḥsaṅgasaṅgamiha nāma kathaṃ vadāmi .
niḥsārasārarahitaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-4..
verses.colloquial:
nishkaama kaamam iha naama katham vadaami
nihsanga sangam iha naama katham vadaami .
nihsaara saara rahitam ca katham vadaami
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-4..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly, how can I say that Brahman has desire, or that It is free of desire? How can I say whether It is attached or detached? How can I say that It is unreal, or that It lacks substance? I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
अद्वैतरूपमखिलं हि कथं वदामि
द्वैतस्वरूपमखिलं हि कथं वदामि ।
नित्यं त्वनित्यमखिलं हि कथं वदामि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-५॥
verses.roman:
advaitarūpamakhilaṃ hi kathaṃ vadāmi
dvaitasvarūpamakhilaṃ hi kathaṃ vadāmi .
nityaṃ tvanityamakhilaṃ hi kathaṃ vadāmi
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-5..
verses.colloquial:
advaita ruupam akhilam hi katham vadaami
dvaita svaruupam akhilam hi katham vadaami .
nityam tu anityam akhilam hi katham vadaami
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-5..
verses.translation_reworded: How could I say whether Brahman is non-dual or dual in nature? How could I say whether It is eternal or not eternal? I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
स्थूलं हि नो न हि कृशं न गतागतं हि
आद्यन्तमध्यरहितं न परापरं हि ।
सत्यं वदामि खलु वै परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-६॥
verses.roman:
sthūlaṃ hi no na hi kṛśaṃ na gatāgataṃ hi
ādyantamadhyarahitaṃ na parāparaṃ hi .
satyaṃ vadāmi khalu vai paramārthatattvaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-6..
verses.colloquial:
sthuulam hi no na hi krisham na gata aagatam hi
aadi anta madhya rahitam na para aparam hi .
satyam vadaami khalu vai parama artha tattvam
jnaana amritam sama rasam gagana upamo aham ..3-6..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is neither gross nor subtle. It neither appears nor vanishes. It has no beginning, no middle, and no end. In Brahman there is nothing higher or lower. I am declaring the Truth, the Ultimate Reality itself. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
संविद्धि सर्वकरणानि नभोनिभानि
संविद्धि सर्वविषयांश्च नभोनिभांश्च ।
संविद्धि चैकममलं न हि बन्धमुक्तं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-७॥
verses.roman:
saṃviddhi sarvakaraṇāni nabhonibhāni
saṃviddhi sarvaviṣayāṃśca nabhonibhāṃśca .
saṃviddhi caikamamalaṃ na hi bandhamuktaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-7..
verses.colloquial:
samviddhi sarva karanaani nabho nibhaani
samviddhi sarva vishayaamsh cha nabho nibhaamsh cha .
samviddhi cha ekam amalam na hi bandha muktam
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-7..
verses.translation_reworded: Be certain of this: the sense organs and their objects are like clouds in the sky. Recognize the Shining One as neither bound nor free. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
दुर्बोधबोधगहनो न भवामि तात
दुर्लक्ष्यलक्ष्यगहनो न भवामि तात ।
आसन्नरूपगहनो न भवामि तात
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-८॥
verses.roman:
durbodhabodhagahano na bhavāmi tāta
durlakṣyalakṣyagahano na bhavāmi tāta .
āsannarūpagahano na bhavāmi tāta
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-8..
verses.colloquial:
durbodha bodha gahano na bhavaami taata
durlakshya lakshya gahano na bhavaami taata .
aasanna ruupa gahano na bhavaami taata
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-8..
verses.translation_reworded: Dear one, I am neither beyond the intellect's grasp nor out of its reach. I am neither imperceptible nor beyond perception. I am neither close to sight nor impenetrable to it. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निष्कर्मकर्मदहनो ज्वलनो भवामि
निर्दुःखदुःखदहनो ज्वलनो भवामि ।
निर्देहदेहदहनो ज्वलनो भवामि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-९॥
verses.roman:
niṣkarmakarmadahano jvalano bhavāmi
nirduḥkhaduḥkhadahano jvalano bhavāmi .
nirdehadehadahano jvalano bhavāmi
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-9..
verses.colloquial:
nishkarma karma dahano jvalano bhavaami
nirduhkha duhkha dahano jvalano bhavaami .
nirdeha deha dahano jvalano bhavaami
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-9..
verses.translation_reworded: I am the fire of knowledge that consumes every action of the actionless Atman. I am the fire of knowledge that destroys every sorrow of the sorrowless Atman. I am the fire of knowledge that burns away every body of the bodiless Atman. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निष्पापपापदहनो हि हुताशनोऽहं
निर्धर्मधर्मदहनो हि हुताशनोऽहम् ।
निर्बन्धबन्धदहनो हि हुताशनोऽहं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-१०॥
verses.roman:
niṣpāpapāpadahano hi hutāśano'haṃ
nirdharmadharmadahano hi hutāśano'ham .
nirbandhabandhadahano hi hutāśano'haṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-10..
verses.colloquial:
nishpaapa paapa dahano hi hutaashano aham
nirdharma dharma dahano hi hutaashano aham .
nirbandha bandha dahano hi hutaashano aham
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-10..
verses.translation_reworded: I am the fire of knowledge that wipes away every sin of the sinless Atman. I am the fire of knowledge that destroys every attribute of the attributeless Atman. I am the fire of knowledge that annihilates every bond of the unbound Atman. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्भावभावरहितो न भवामि वत्स
निर्योगयोगरहितो न भवामि वत्स ।
निश्चित्तचित्तरहितो न भवामि वत्स
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-११॥
verses.roman:
nirbhāvabhāvarahito na bhavāmi vatsa
niryogayogarahito na bhavāmi vatsa .
niścittacittarahito na bhavāmi vatsa
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-11..
verses.colloquial:
nir bhaava bhaava rahito na bhavaami vatsa
nir yoga yoga rahito na bhavaami vatsa .
nish citta citta rahito na bhavaami vatsa
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-11..
verses.translation_reworded: My dear, I am neither free of thought nor possessed of thought. I am neither separated nor joined. I am neither without a mind nor in possession of one. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्मोहमोहपदवीति न मे विकल्पो
निःशोकशोकपदवीति न मे विकल्पः ।
निर्लोभलोभपदवीति न मे विकल्पो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-१२॥
verses.roman:
nirmohamohapadavīti na me vikalpo
niḥśokaśokapadavīti na me vikalpaḥ .
nirlobhalobhapadavīti na me vikalpo
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-12..
verses.colloquial:
nirmoha moha padaviiti na me vikalpo
nihshoka shoka padaviiti na me vikalpah .
nirlobha lobha padaviiti na me vikalpo
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-12..
verses.translation_reworded: In my Self there are no alternatives such as delusion or its absence, grief or its absence, greed or its absence. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
संसारसन्ततिलता न च मे कदाचित्
सन्तोषसन्ततिसुखो न च मे कदाचित् ।
अज्ञानबन्धनमिदं न च मे कदाचित्
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-१३॥
verses.roman:
saṃsārasantatilatā na ca me kadācit
santoṣasantatisukho na ca me kadācit .
ajñānabandhanamidaṃ na ca me kadācit
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-13..
verses.colloquial:
samsaara santati lataa na ca me kadaacit
santoshaa santati sukho na ca me kadaacit .
ajnaana bandhanam idam na ca me kadaacit
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-13..
verses.translation_reworded: I am never caught by the creeper of endless birth and death. Neither the vast joy of contentment nor the bondage of ignorance exists in me. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
संसारसन्ततिरजो न च मे विकारः
सन्तापसन्ततितमो न च मे विकारः ।
सत्त्वं स्वधर्मजनकं न च मे विकारो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-१४॥
verses.roman:
saṃsārasantatirajo na ca me vikāraḥ
santāpasantatitamo na ca me vikāraḥ .
sattvaṃ svadharmajanakaṃ na ca me vikāro
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-14..
verses.colloquial:
samsaara santati rajo na ca me vikaarah
santaapa santati tamo na ca me vikaarah .
sattvam sva dharma janakam na ca me vikaaro
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-14..
verses.translation_reworded: The continuation of the world is a modification of rajas, not of me. The chain of suffering is a modification of tamas, not of me. Happiness is a modification of sattva, not of me. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
सन्तापदुःखजनको न विधिः कदाचित्
सन्तापयोगजनितं न मनः कदाचित् ।
यस्मादहङ्कृतिरियं न च मे कदाचित्
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-१५॥
verses.roman:
santāpaduḥkhajanako na vidhiḥ kadācit
santāpayogajanitaṃ na manaḥ kadācit .
yasmādahaṅkṛtiriyaṃ na ca me kadācit
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-15..
verses.colloquial:
