santaapa duhkha janako na vidhih kadaacit
santaapa yoga janitam na manah kadaacit .
yasmaad ahankritir iyam na ca me kadaacit
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-15..
verses.translation_reworded: I have never done any action that could produce anguish and misery. I have never had a mind that could operate through contact with pain and pleasure. There is no root of ego in me. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निष्कम्पकम्पनिधनं न विकल्पकल्पं
स्वप्नप्रबोधनिधनं न हिताहितं हि ।
निःसारसारनिधनं न चराचरं हि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-१६॥
verses.roman:
niṣkampakampanidhanaṃ na vikalpakalpaṃ
svapnaprabodhanidhanaṃ na hitāhitaṃ hi .
niḥsārasāranidhanaṃ na carācaraṃ hi
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-16..
verses.colloquial:
nishkampa kampa nidhanam na vikalpa kalpam
svapna prabodha nidhanam na hita ahitam hi |
nihsaara saara nidhanam na cara acaram hi
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-16..
verses.translation_reworded: Stillness and vibration, doubt and resolve, both end in Brahman. The waking and dreaming states, good and evil, both come to rest in Brahman. Strength and weakness, motion and rest, both dissolve in Brahman. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
नो वेद्यवेदकमिदं न च हेतुतर्क्यं
वाचामगोचरमिदं न मनो न बुद्धिः ।
एवं कथं हि भवतः कथयामि तत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-१७॥
verses.roman:
no vedyavedakamidaṃ na ca hetutarkyaṃ
vācāmagocaramidaṃ na mano na buddhiḥ .
evaṃ kathaṃ hi bhavataḥ kathayāmi tattvaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-17..
verses.colloquial:
no vedya vedakam idam na ca hetu tarkyam
vaacaam agocaram idam na mano na buddhih .
evam katham hi bhavatah kathayaami tattvam
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-17..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is neither the knower nor the thing known. It lies beyond speculation and logical reasoning. It is beyond the reach of speech, mind, and intellect. So how can I tell you about Brahman, the Ultimate Reality? I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्भिन्नभिन्नरहितं परमार्थतत्त्व-
मन्तर्बहिर्न हि कथं परमार्थतत्त्वम् ।
प्राक्सम्भवं न च रतं न हि वस्तु किञ्चित्
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-१८॥
verses.roman:
nirbhinnabhinnarahitaṃ paramārthatattva-
mantarbahirna hi kathaṃ paramārthatattvam .
prāksambhavaṃ na ca rataṃ na hi vastu kiñcit
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-18..
verses.colloquial:
nirbhinna bhinna rahitam paramaartha tattva
mantar bahir na hi katham paramaartha tattvam .
praak sambhavam na ca ratam na hi vastu kincit
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-18..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is neither undivided nor divided. It truly has no inside and no outside. Brahman is not something that came into being in the past and will later cease to be. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
रागादिदोषरहितं त्वहमेव तत्त्वं
दैवादिदोषरहितं त्वहमेव तत्त्वम् ।
संसारशोकरहितं त्वहमेव तत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-१९॥
verses.roman:
rāgādidoṣarahitaṃ tvahameva tattvaṃ
daivādidoṣarahitaṃ tvahameva tattvam .
saṃsāraśokarahitaṃ tvahameva tattvaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-19..
verses.colloquial:
raagaadi dosha rahitam tv aham eva tattvam
daivaadi dosha rahitam tv aham eva tattvam .
samsaara shoka rahitam tv aham eva tattvam
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-19..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly I am Brahman, free of passion, jealousy, hatred, and the rest. I am that Reality without the sufferings that come from physical, earthly, and supernatural causes. I am that Truth untouched by the grief and misery of the world. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
स्थानत्रयं यदि च नेति कथं तुरीयं
कालत्रयं यदि च नेति कथं दिशश्च ।
शान्तं पदं हि परमं परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२०॥
verses.roman:
sthānatrayaṃ yadi ca neti kathaṃ turīyaṃ
kālatrayaṃ yadi ca neti kathaṃ diśaśca .
śāntaṃ padaṃ hi paramaṃ paramārthatattvaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-20..
verses.colloquial:
sthaana trayam yadi ca na iti katham turiiyam
kaala trayam yadi ca na iti katham dishash ca .
shaantam padam hi paramam parama artha tattvam
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-20..
verses.translation_reworded: How can there be a Fourth [Transcendental state] when Brahman has no three states [waking, dreaming, and sleeping]? How can the four directions of space exist without the threefold division of time? Truly, Brahman is the supreme home of peace. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
दीर्घो लघुः पुनरितीह नमे विभागो
विस्तारसंकटमितीह न मे विभागः ।
कोणं हि वर्तुलमितीह न मे विभागो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२१॥
verses.roman:
dīrgho laghuḥ punaritīha name vibhāgo
vistārasaṃkaṭamitīha na me vibhāgaḥ .
koṇaṃ hi vartulamitīha na me vibhāgo
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-21..
verses.colloquial:
diirgho laghuh punar itiiha na me vibhaago
vistaara samkatam itiiha na me vibhaagah .
konam hi vartulam itiiha na me vibhaago
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-21..
verses.translation_reworded: Again, in my Self there are no divisions such as long or short, wide or narrow, round or angular. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
मातापितादि तनयादि न मे कदाचित्
जातं मृतं न च मनो न च मे कदाचित् ।
निर्व्याकुलं स्थिरमिदं परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२२॥
verses.roman:
mātāpitādi tanayādi na me kadācit
jātaṃ mṛtaṃ na ca mano na ca me kadācit .
nirvyākulaṃ sthiramidaṃ paramārthatattvaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-22..
verses.colloquial:
maataa pitaa aadi tanaya aadi na me kadaacit
jaatam mritam na ca mano na ca me kadaacit .
nirvyaakulam sthiram idam paramaartha tattvam
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-22..
verses.translation_reworded: I have no mother, no father, and no children. I have no birth, no death, and no desire. Truly, the Supreme Reality is unshakable and calm. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
शुद्धं विशुद्धमविचारमनन्तरूपं
निर्लेपलेपमविचारमनन्तरूपम् ।
निष्खण्डखण्डमविचारमनन्तरूपं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२३॥
verses.roman:
śuddhaṃ viśuddhamavicāramanantarūpaṃ
nirlepalepamavicāramanantarūpam .
niṣkhaṇḍakhaṇḍamavicāramanantarūpaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-23..
verses.colloquial:
shuddham vishuddham avicaaram ananta ruupam
nirlepa lepam avicaaram ananta ruupam .
nishkhanda khandam avicaaram ananta ruupam
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-23..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is radiant, utterly pure, infinite, and beyond the intellect. It is foolish to think of the infinite Brahman as either unpolluted or polluted, undivided or divided. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मादयः सुरगणाः कथमत्र सन्ति
स्वर्गादयो वसतयः कथमत्र सन्ति ।
यद्येकरूपममलं परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२४॥
verses.roman:
brahmādayaḥ suragaṇāḥ kathamatra santi
svargādayo vasatayaḥ kathamatra santi .
yadyekarūpamamalaṃ paramārthatattvaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-24..
verses.colloquial:
brahma aadayah sura ganaah katham atra santi
svarga aadayo vasatayah katham atra santi .
yady eka ruupam amalam parama artha tattvam
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-24..
verses.translation_reworded: If the Supreme Reality is one and the same and utterly pure, how can there be so many gods, such as Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, or so many realms, such as Brahmaloka, heaven, and earth? I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्नेति नेति विमलो हि कथं वदामि
निःशेषशेषविमलो हि कथं वदामि ।
निर्लिङ्गलिङ्गविमलो हि कथं वदामि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२५॥
verses.roman:
nirneti neti vimalo hi kathaṃ vadāmi
niḥśeṣaśeṣavimalo hi kathaṃ vadāmi .
nirliṅgaliṅgavimalo hi kathaṃ vadāmi
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-25..
verses.colloquial:
nir neti neti vimalo hi katham vadaami
nihshesha shesha vimalo hi katham vadaami .
nir linga linga vimalo hi katham vadaami
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-25..
verses.translation_reworded: How can I say that the Supreme Reality is not this or not that, that It is endless or has an end, that It is bodiless or has a body? I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निष्कर्मकर्मपरमं सततं करोमि
निःसङ्गसङ्गरहितं परमं विनोदम् ।
निर्देहदेहरहितं सततं विनोदं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२६॥
verses.roman:
niṣkarmakarmaparamaṃ satataṃ karomi
niḥsaṅgasaṅgarahitaṃ paramaṃ vinodam .
nirdehadeharahitaṃ satataṃ vinodaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-26..
verses.colloquial:
nishkarma karma paramam satatam karomi
nihsanga sanga rahitam paramam vinodam .
nirdeha deha rahitam satatam vinodam
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-26..
verses.translation_reworded: Though I perform no action, I am always engaged in the highest activity. Being unattached, I enjoy the bliss of non-attachment. Being bodiless, I enjoy the happiness of having no body. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
मायाप्रपञ्चरचना न च मे विकारः ।
कौटिल्यदम्भरचना न च मे विकारः ।
सत्यानृतेति रचना न च मे विकारो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२७॥
verses.roman:
māyāprapañcaracanā na ca me vikāraḥ .
kauṭilyadambharacanā na ca me vikāraḥ .
satyānṛteti racanā na ca me vikāro
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-27..
verses.colloquial:
maayaa prapanca racanaa na ca me vikaarah .
kautilya dambha racanaa na ca me vikaarah .
satya anriteti racanaa na ca me vikaaro
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-27..
verses.translation_reworded: The beautiful creation of maya produces no change in my Self. Neither crookedness and deceit nor truth and falsehood have any effect on me. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
सन्ध्यादिकालरहितं न च मे वियोगो-
ह्यन्तः प्रबोधरहितं बधिरो न मूकः ।
एवं विकल्परहितं न च भावशुद्धं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२८॥
verses.roman:
sandhyādikālarahitaṃ na ca me viyogo-
hyantaḥ prabodharahitaṃ badhiro na mūkaḥ .
evaṃ vikalparahitaṃ na ca bhāvaśuddhaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-28..
verses.colloquial:
sandhyaadi kaala rahitam na ca me viyogo
hy antah prabodha rahitam badhiro na muukah .
evam vikalpa rahitam na ca bhaava shuddham
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-28..
verses.translation_reworded: Though I am beyond divisions of time such as evening and morning, I am never absent. Though I have no differentiated knowledge, I am not deaf or mute. Since I am free of ignorance, I need no purification of the mind. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्नाथनाथरहितं हि निराकुलं वै
निश्चित्तचित्तविगतं हि निराकुलं वै ।
संविद्धि सर्वविगतं हि निराकुलं वै
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-२९॥
verses.roman:
nirnāthanātharahitaṃ hi nirākulaṃ vai
niścittacittavigataṃ hi nirākulaṃ vai .
saṃviddhi sarvavigataṃ hi nirākulaṃ vai
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-29..
verses.colloquial:
nir naatha naatha rahitam hi niraakulam vai
nish citta citta vigatam hi niraakulam vai .
samviddhi sarva vigatam hi niraakulam vai
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-29..
verses.translation_reworded: I have no master and I am no master, so I am free of perplexity. I have gone beyond the mind, which has stopped functioning, so I have no perplexity. Know for certain that all dualities have ended for me, so I have no perplexity. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
कान्तारमन्दिरमिदं हि कथं वदामि
संसिद्धसंशयमिदं हि कथं वदामि ।
एवं निरन्तरसमं हि निराकुलं वै
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३०॥
verses.roman:
kāntāramandiramidaṃ hi kathaṃ vadāmi
saṃsiddhasaṃśayamidaṃ hi kathaṃ vadāmi .
evaṃ nirantarasamaṃ hi nirākulaṃ vai
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-30..
verses.colloquial:
kaantaara mandiram idam hi katham vadaami
samsiddha samshayam idam hi katham vadaami .
evam nirantara samam hi niraakulam vai
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-30..
verses.translation_reworded: How can I say that Brahman is like a forest or a temple? How can I declare that Brahman is proven or doubtful? Truly, It is all-pervading, unaffected, and motionless. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
निर्जीवजीवरहितं सततं विभाति
निर्बीजबीजरहितं सततं विभाति ।
निर्वाणबन्धरहितं सततं विभाति
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३१॥
verses.roman:
nirjīvajīvarahitaṃ satataṃ vibhāti
nirbījabījarahitaṃ satataṃ vibhāti .
nirvāṇabandharahitaṃ satataṃ vibhāti
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-31..
verses.colloquial:
nirjiiva jiiva rahitam satatam vibhaati
nirbiija biija rahitam satatam vibhaati .
nirvaana bandha rahitam satatam vibhaati
jnaanaamritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-31..
verses.translation_reworded: Having neither matter nor life, Brahman shines forever. Having neither origin nor seed, It exists forever. Being neither free nor bound, Brahman shines forever. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
सम्भूतिवर्जितमिदं सततं विभाति
संसारवर्जितमिदं सततं विभाति ।
संहारवर्जितमिदं सततं विभाति
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३२॥
verses.roman:
sambhūtivarjitamidaṃ satataṃ vibhāti
saṃsāravarjitamidaṃ satataṃ vibhāti .
saṃhāravarjitamidaṃ satataṃ vibhāti
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-32..
verses.colloquial:
sambhuuti varjitam idam satatam vibhaati
samsaara varjitam idam satatam vibhaati .
samhaara varjitam idam satatam vibhaati
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-32..
verses.translation_reworded: Having no origin, Brahman shines forever. Having no phenomenal existence, It radiates forever. Never being destroyed, It exists forever. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
उल्लेखमात्रमपि ते न च नामरूपं
निर्भिन्नभिन्नमपि ते न हि वस्तु किञ्चित् ।
निर्लज्जमानस करोषि कथं विषादं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३३॥
verses.roman:
ullekhamātramapi te na ca nāmarūpaṃ
nirbhinnabhinnamapi te na hi vastu kiñcit .
nirlajjamānasa karoṣi kathaṃ viṣādaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-33..
verses.colloquial:
ullekha maatram api te na ca naama ruupam
nirbhinna bhinnam api te na hi vastu kincit .
nirlajja maanasa karoshi katham vishaadam
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-33..
verses.translation_reworded: [O Self,] You have no name and no form, not even by way of the faintest hint. There is no substance that is either different from You or not different from You. Why, then, O shameless mind, do you grieve? I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न जरा न मृत्युः
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च जन्म दुःखम् ।
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते विकारो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३४॥
verses.roman:
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na jarā na mṛtyuḥ
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca janma duḥkham .
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca te vikāro
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-34..
verses.colloquial:
kim naama rodishi sakhe na jaraa na mrityuh
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca janma duhkham .
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca te vikaaro
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-34..
verses.translation_reworded: Why do you cry, my friend? For you there is no old age and no death. For you there is no birth and no misery. Why do you cry, my friend? For you there is no disease and no change. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते स्वरूपं
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते विरूपम् ।
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते वयांसि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३५॥
verses.roman:
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca te svarūpaṃ
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca te virūpam .
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca te vayāṃsi
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-35..
verses.colloquial:
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca te svaruupam
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca te viruupam .
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca te vayaamsi
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-35..
verses.translation_reworded: Why do you cry, my friend? You have no form, nor are you deformed. Why do you cry, my friend? There is no aging for you. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते वयांसि
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते मनांसि ।
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न तवेन्द्रियाणि
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३६॥
verses.roman:
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca te vayāṃsi
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca te manāṃsi .
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na tavendriyāṇi
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-36..
verses.colloquial:
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca te vayaamsi
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca te manaamsi .
kim naama rodishi sakhe na tavendriyaani
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-36..
verses.translation_reworded: Why do you cry, my friend? You have no physical or mental organism. Why do you cry, my friend? You have no sense organs at all. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च तेऽस्ति कामः
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते प्रलोभः ।
किं नाम रोदिषि सखे न च ते विमोहो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३७॥
verses.roman:
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca te'sti kāmaḥ
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca te pralobhaḥ .
kiṃ nāma rodiṣi sakhe na ca te vimoho
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-37..
verses.colloquial:
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca te asti kaamah
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca te pralobhah .
kim naama rodishi sakhe na ca te vimoho
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-37..
verses.translation_reworded: Why do you cry, my friend? You have no lust and no greed. Why do you cry, my friend? You have no delusion. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
ऐश्वर्यमिच्छसि कथं न च ते धनानि
ऐश्वर्यमिच्छसि कथं न च ते हि पत्नी ।
ऐश्वर्यमिच्छसि कथं न च ते ममेति
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३८॥
verses.roman:
aiśvaryamicchasi kathaṃ na ca te dhanāni
aiśvaryamicchasi kathaṃ na ca te hi patnī .
aiśvaryamicchasi kathaṃ na ca te mameti
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-38..
verses.colloquial:
aishvaryam icchasi katham na ca te dhanaani
aishvaryam icchasi katham na ca te hi patnii .
aishvaryam icchasi katham na ca te mameti
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-38..
verses.translation_reworded: How can you want sovereignty when you have no wealth? Why do you chase wealth when you have no wife? Since you have no sense of ownership, what would you do with wealth? I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
लिङ्गप्रपञ्चजनुषी न च ते न मे च
निर्लज्जमानसमिदं च विभाति भिन्नम् ।
निर्भेदभेदरहितं न च ते न मे च
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-३९॥
verses.roman:
liṅgaprapañcajanuṣī na ca te na me ca
nirlajjamānasamidaṃ ca vibhāti bhinnam .
nirbhedabhedarahitaṃ na ca te na me ca
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-39..
verses.colloquial:
linga prapanca janushii na ca te na me ca
nirlajja maanasam idam ca vibhaati bhinnam .
nirbheda bheda rahitam na ca te na me ca
jnaana amritam samarasam gagana upamo aham ..3-39..
verses.translation_reworded: The creation of the subtle and gross universe is neither for you nor for me. The shameless mind invented the idea of diversity. For you and for me there is neither unity nor diversity. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
नो वाणुमात्रमपि ते हि विरागरूपं
नो वाणुमात्रमपि ते हि सरागरूपम् ।
नो वाणुमात्रमपि ते हि सकामरूपं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-४०॥
verses.roman:
no vāṇumātramapi te hi virāgarūpaṃ
no vāṇumātramapi te hi sarāgarūpam .
no vāṇumātramapi te hi sakāmarūpaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-40..
verses.colloquial:
no vaanumaatram api te hi viraaga ruupam
no vaanumaatram api te hi saraaga ruupam .
no vaanumaatram api te hi sakaama ruupam
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-40..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly, there is not a trace of attachment or detachment in your real nature. Truly, you have not the slightest form of desire. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्याता न ते हि हृदये न च ते समाधि-
र्ध्यानं न ते हि हृदये न बहिः प्रदेशः ।
ध्येयं न चेति हृदये न हि वस्तु कालो
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-४१॥
verses.roman:
dhyātā na te hi hṛdaye na ca te samādhi-
rdhyānaṃ na te hi hṛdaye na bahiḥ pradeśaḥ .
dhyeyaṃ na ceti hṛdaye na hi vastu kālo
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-41..
verses.colloquial:
dhyaataa na te hi hridaye na ca te samaadhi
rdhyaanam na te hi hridaye na bahih pradeshah .
dhyeyam na ceti hridaye na hi vastu kaalo
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-41..
verses.translation_reworded: Truly, there is no one meditating within your heart, so you have no samadhi. There is no meditation within your heart, because there is no space outside it. Indeed, there is no object of meditation within your heart, since there is no object and no time. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्सारभूतमखिलं कथितं मया ते
न त्वं न मे न महतो न गुरुर्न न शिष्यः ।
स्वच्छन्दरूपसहजं परमार्थतत्त्वं
ज्ञानामृतं समरसं गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ३-४२॥
verses.roman:
yatsārabhūtamakhilaṃ kathitaṃ mayā te
na tvaṃ na me na mahato na gururna na śiṣyaḥ .
svacchandarūpasahajaṃ paramārthatattvaṃ
jñānāmṛtaṃ samarasaṃ gaganopamo'ham ..3-42..
verses.colloquial:
yat saara bhuutam akhilam kathitam mayaa te
na tvam na me na mahato na gurur na na shishyah .
svacchanda ruupa sahajam paramaartha tattvam
jnaanaamritam samarasam gaganopamo aham ..3-42..
verses.translation_reworded: I have told you the very essence of the Supreme Reality. There is no you, no I, no superior, no teacher, and no disciple. The Ultimate Reality is simple and spontaneous. I am Existence-Knowledge-Bliss, as limitless as space.

verses.sanskrit:
कथमिह परमार्थं तत्त्वमानन्दरूपं
कथमिह परमार्थं नैवमानन्दरूपम् ।
कथमिह परमार्थं ज्ञानविज्ञानरूपं
यदि परमहमेकं वर्तते व्योमरूपम् ॥ ३-४३॥
verses.roman:
kathamiha paramārthaṃ tattvamānandarūpaṃ
kathamiha paramārthaṃ naivamānandarūpam .
kathamiha paramārthaṃ jñānavijñānarūpaṃ
yadi paramahamekaṃ vartate vyomarūpam ..3-43..
verses.colloquial:
katham iha paramaartham tattvam aananda ruupam
katham iha paramaartham na evam aananda ruupam .
katham iha paramaartham jnaana vijnaana ruupam
yadi param aham ekam vartate vyoma ruupam ..3-43..
verses.translation_reworded: If I, the Supreme One, alone exist, like space, how can I say the Supreme Reality is blissful or not blissful? How can I say that It is reached through knowledge or through realization?

verses.sanskrit:
दहनपवनहीनं विद्धि विज्ञानमेक-
मवनिजलविहीनं विद्धि विज्ञानरूपम् ।
समगमनविहीनं विद्धि विज्ञानमेकं
गगनमिव विशालं विद्धि विज्ञानमेकम् ॥ ३-४४॥
verses.roman:
dahanapavanahīnaṃ viddhi vijñānameka-
mavanijalavihīnaṃ viddhi vijñānarūpam .
samagamanavihīnaṃ viddhi vijñānamekaṃ
gaganamiva viśālaṃ viddhi vijñānamekam ..3-44..
verses.colloquial:
dahana pavana hiinam viddhi vijnaanam ekam
avani jala vihiinam viddhi vijnaana ruupam .
samagamana vihiinam viddhi vijnaanam ekam
gaganam iva vishaalam viddhi vijnaanam ekam ..3-44..
verses.translation_reworded: Realize that non-dual Consciousness, which has no fire or air, no earth or water. Realize that non-dual Consciousness, which is neither moving nor still. Realize that non-dual Consciousness, which is as vast as space.

verses.sanskrit:
न शून्यरूपं न विशून्यरूपं
न शुद्धरूपं न विशुद्धरूपम् ।
रूपं विरूपं न भवामि किञ्चित्
स्वरूपरूपं परमार्थतत्त्वम् ॥ ३-४५॥
verses.roman:
na śūnyarūpaṃ na viśūnyarūpaṃ
na śuddharūpaṃ na viśuddharūpam .
rūpaṃ virūpaṃ na bhavāmi kiñcit
svarūparūpaṃ paramārthatattvam ..3-45..
verses.colloquial:
na shuunya ruupam na vishuunya ruupam
na shuddha ruupam na vishuddha ruupam .
ruupam viruupam na bhavaami kincit
svaruupa ruupam paramaartha tattvam ..3-45..
verses.translation_reworded: Formless I am not, nor do I have form. Purity and impurity are not my nature, nor are beauty and ugliness. That Supreme Reality shining in Its own nature is what I am.

verses.sanskrit:
मुञ्च मुञ्च हि संसारं त्यागं मुञ्च हि सर्वथा ।
त्यागात्यागविषं शुद्धममृतं सहजं ध्रुवम् ॥ ३-४६॥
verses.roman:
muñca muñca hi saṃsāraṃ tyāgaṃ muñca hi sarvathā .
tyāgātyāgaviṣaṃ śuddhamamṛtaṃ sahajaṃ dhruvam ..3-46..
verses.colloquial:
munca munca hi samsaaram tyaagam munca hi sarvathaa .
tyaaga atyaaga visham shuddham amritam sahajam dhruvam ..3-46..
verses.translation_reworded: Renounce, renounce worldly existence, and then renounce even that renunciation completely. Cast off, as you would poison, the egoistic notion of rejecting or accepting the world. You are pure, simple, steady, and immortal.

verses.sanskrit:
<vt>अथ चतुर्थोऽध्यायः</vt>
नावाहनं नैव विसर्जनं वा
पुष्पाणि पत्राणि कथं भवन्ति ।
ध्यानानि मन्त्राणि कथं भवन्ति
समासमं चैव शिवार्चनं च ॥ ४-१॥
verses.roman:
<vt>Chapter 4</vt>
nāvāhanaṃ naiva visarjanaṃ vā
puṣpāṇi patrāṇi kathaṃ bhavanti .
dhyānāni mantrāṇi kathaṃ bhavanti
samāsamaṃ caiva śivārcanaṃ ca ..4-1..
verses.colloquial:
<vt>Chapter 4</vt>
na aavaahanam na eva visarjanam vaa
pushpaani patraani katham bhavanti .
dhyaanaani mantraani katham bhavanti
samaasamam cha eva shiva archanam cha ..4-1..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman can be neither invoked nor abandoned, because It has no form. What use, then, is offering flowers and leaves, practicing meditation, or repeating the mantra? How can anyone worship that Supreme Bliss in which both unity and diversity dissolve?

verses.sanskrit:
न केवलं बन्धविबन्धमुक्तो
न केवलं शुद्धविशुद्धमुक्तः ।
न केवलं योगवियोगमुक्तः
स वै विमुक्तो गगनोपमोऽहम् ॥ ४-२॥
verses.roman:
na kevalaṃ bandhavibandhamukto
na kevalaṃ śuddhaviśuddhamuktaḥ .
na kevalaṃ yogaviyogamuktaḥ
sa vai vimukto gaganopamo'ham ..4-2..
verses.colloquial:
na kevalam bandha vibandha mukto
na kevalam shuddha vishuddha muktah .
na kevalam yoga viyoga muktah
sa vai vimukto gagana upamo aham ..4-2..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is not merely free from bondage and liberation, purity and impurity, union and separation; It is truly ever free. And I am that Brahman, infinite as space.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जायते सर्वमिदं हि तथ्यं
सञ्जायते सर्वमिदं वितथ्यम् ।
एवं विकल्पो मम नैव जातः
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-३॥
verses.roman:
sañjāyate sarvamidaṃ hi tathyaṃ
sañjāyate sarvamidaṃ vitathyam .
evaṃ vikalpo mama naiva jātaḥ
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-3..
verses.colloquial:
sanjaayate sarvam idam hi tathyam
sanjaayate sarvam idam vitathyam .
evam vikalpo mama na eva jaatah
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-3..
verses.translation_reworded: Whether the manifested world is real or unreal, no such doubt ever arises in my mind. By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
न साञ्जनं चैव निरञ्जनं वा
न चान्तरं वापि निरन्तरं वा ।
अन्तर्विभन्नं न हि मे विभाति
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-४॥
verses.roman:
na sāñjanaṃ caiva nirañjanaṃ vā
na cāntaraṃ vāpi nirantaraṃ vā .
antarvibhannaṃ na hi me vibhāti
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-4..
verses.colloquial:
na saanjanam caiva niranjanam vaa
na ca antaram vaa api nirantaram vaa .
antar vibhannam na hi me vibhaati
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-4..
verses.translation_reworded: Neither darkness nor light, neither inside nor outside, nor any other kind of diversity appears in my Self. By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
अबोधबोधो मम नैव जातो
बोधस्वरूपं मम नैव जातम् ।
निर्बोधबोधं च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-५॥
verses.roman:
abodhabodho mama naiva jāto
bodhasvarūpaṃ mama naiva jātam .
nirbodhabodhaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-5..
verses.colloquial:
abodha bodho mama naiva jaato
bodha svaruupam mama naiva jaatam .
nirbodha bodham ca katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-5..
verses.translation_reworded: Neither ignorance nor knowledge arises in me. Even knowledge of the Self does not arise in me. How can I claim to have ignorance or knowledge? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
न धर्मयुक्तो न च पापयुक्तो
न बन्धयुक्तो न च मोक्षयुक्तः ।
युक्तं त्वयुक्तं न च मे विभाति
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-६॥
verses.roman:
na dharmayukto na ca pāpayukto
na bandhayukto na ca mokṣayuktaḥ .
yuktaṃ tvayuktaṃ na ca me vibhāti
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-6..
verses.colloquial:
na dharma yukto na ca paapa yukto
na bandha yukto na ca moksha yuktah .
yuktam tv ayuktam na ca me vibhaati
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-6..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman has no connection with virtue and vice or with bondage and freedom. Nothing appears to me as joined or as separated. By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
परापरं वा न च मे कदाचित्
मध्यस्थभावो हि न चारिमित्रम् ।
हिताहितं चापि कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-७॥
verses.roman:
parāparaṃ vā na ca me kadācit
madhyasthabhāvo hi na cārimitram .
hitāhitaṃ cāpi kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-7..
verses.colloquial:
paraaparam vaa na ca me kadaacit
madhyastha bhaavo hi na ca ari mitram .
hitaahitam caapi katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-7..
verses.translation_reworded: No one is above me or below me. I have no notion of neutrality, and I have neither enemy nor friend. How can I speak of good and evil? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
नोपासको नैवमुपास्यरूपं
न चोपदेशो न च मे क्रिया च ।
संवित्स्वरूपं च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-८॥
verses.roman:
nopāsako naivamupāsyarūpaṃ
na copadeśo na ca me kriyā ca .
saṃvitsvarūpaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-8..
verses.colloquial:
na upaasako naivam upaasya ruupam
na ca upadesho na ca me kriyaa ca .
samvit svaruupam ca katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-8..
verses.translation_reworded: I am neither the worshipper nor the thing worshipped. Instructions and rituals are not intended for me. How can I describe the nature of absolute Consciousness? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
नो व्यापकं व्याप्यमिहास्ति किञ्चित्
न चालयं वापि निरालयं वा ।
अशून्यशून्यं च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-९॥
verses.roman:
no vyāpakaṃ vyāpyamihāsti kiñcit
na cālayaṃ vāpi nirālayaṃ vā .
aśūnyaśūnyaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-9..
verses.colloquial:
no vyaapakam vyaapyam ihaasti kincit
na caalayam vaapi niraalayam vaa .
ashuunya shuunyam ca katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-9..
verses.translation_reworded: Nothing pervades Brahman, and Brahman pervades nothing. It neither has a dwelling place nor lacks one. How can I call It full or empty? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
न ग्राहको ग्राह्यकमेव किञ्चित्
न कारणं वा मम नैव कार्यम् ।
अचिन्त्यचिन्त्यं च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-१०॥
verses.roman:
na grāhako grāhyakameva kiñcit
na kāraṇaṃ vā mama naiva kāryam .
acintyacintyaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-10..
verses.colloquial:
na graahako graahyakam eva kincit
na kaaranam vaa mama naiva kaaryam .
acintya cintyam ca katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-10..
verses.translation_reworded: My Self is neither the perceiver nor the thing perceived. It has no cause and no effect. How can I say It is conceivable or inconceivable? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
न भेदकं वापि न चैव भेद्यं
न वेदकं वा मम नैव वेद्यम् ।
गतागतं तात कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-११॥
verses.roman:
na bhedakaṃ vāpi na caiva bhedyaṃ
na vedakaṃ vā mama naiva vedyam .
gatāgataṃ tāta kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-11..
verses.colloquial:
na bhedakam vaapi na caiva bhedyam
na vedakam vaa mama naiva vedyam .
gataagatam taata katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-11..
verses.translation_reworded: My Self destroys nothing, and nothing destroys It. It is neither a knower nor something knowable. Dear one, how can I describe It as coming or going? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
न चास्ति देहो न च मे विदेहो
बुद्धिर्मनो मे न हि चेन्द्रियाणि ।
रागो विरागश्च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-१२॥
verses.roman:
na cāsti deho na ca me videho
buddhirmano me na hi cendriyāṇi .
rāgo virāgaśca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-12..
verses.colloquial:
na ca asti deho na ca me videho
buddhir mano me na hi ca indriyaani .
raago viraagash ca katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-12..
verses.translation_reworded: I have no body, nor am I bodiless. I have no senses, no mind, and no intellect. How can I say I have attachment or detachment? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
उल्लेखमात्रं न हि भिन्नमुच्चै-
रुल्लेखमात्रं न तिरोहितं वै ।
समासमं मित्र कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-१३॥
verses.roman:
ullekhamātraṃ na hi bhinnamuccai-
rullekhamātraṃ na tirohitaṃ vai .
samāsamaṃ mitra kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-13..
verses.colloquial:
ullekha maatram na hi bhinnam uccair
ullekha maatram na tirohitam vai .
samaasamam mitra katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-13..
verses.translation_reworded: Forceful claims cannot alter Brahman, and denying Brahman does not make It vanish. O friend, how can I say whether Brahman is always the same or not? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
जितेन्द्रियोऽहं त्वजितेन्द्रियो वा
न संयमो मे नियमो न जातः ।
जयाजयौ मित्र कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-१४॥
verses.roman:
jitendriyo'haṃ tvajitendriyo vā
na saṃyamo me niyamo na jātaḥ .
jayājayau mitra kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-14..
verses.colloquial:
jitendriyo aham tu ajitendriyo vaa
na samyamo me niyamo na jaatah .
jayaajayau mitra katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-14..
verses.translation_reworded: I have mastered the senses, and then again, I have not mastered them. I have never practiced self-restraint or religious austerities. O friend, how can I speak of success and defeat? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
अमूर्तमूर्तिर्न च मे कदाचि-
दाद्यन्तमध्यं न च मे कदाचित् ।
बलाबलं मित्र कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-१५॥
verses.roman:
amūrtamūrtirna ca me kadāci-
dādyantamadhyaṃ na ca me kadācit .
balābalaṃ mitra kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-15..
verses.colloquial:
amuurta muurtir na ca me kadaaci
daadyanta madhyam na ca me kadaacit .
bala abalam mitra katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-15..
verses.translation_reworded: I have no form, nor am I formless. I have no beginning, middle, or end. Friend, how can I say that I am strong or weak? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
मृतामृतं वापि विषाविषं च
सञ्जायते तात न मे कदाचित् ।
अशुद्धशुद्धं च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-१६॥
verses.roman:
mṛtāmṛtaṃ vāpi viṣāviṣaṃ ca
sañjāyate tāta na me kadācit .
aśuddhaśuddhaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-16..
verses.colloquial:
mritaamritam vaapi vishaavisham ca
sanjaayate taata na me kadaacit .
ashuddhashuddham ca katham vadaami
svaruupanirvaanamanaamayo aham ..4-16..
verses.translation_reworded: My dear, death and immortality, poison and nectar, have never come forth from me. How can I say I am pure or impure? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वप्नः प्रबोधो न च योगमुद्रा
नक्तं दिवा वापि न मे कदाचित् ।
अतुर्यतुर्यं च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-१७॥
verses.roman:
svapnaḥ prabodho na ca yogamudrā
naktaṃ divā vāpi na me kadācit .
aturyaturyaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-17..
verses.colloquial:
svapnah prabodho na ca yoga mudraa
naktam divaa vaapi na me kadaacit .
aturyaturyam ca katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-17..
verses.translation_reworded: For me there is no waking and no dreaming, no yoga posture, and no day or night. How can I say I am in the third state [sleep] or in the Fourth [Transcendental]? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
संविद्धि मां सर्वविसर्वमुक्तं
माया विमाया न च मे कदाचित् ।
सन्ध्यादिकं कर्म कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-१८॥
verses.roman:
saṃviddhi māṃ sarvavisarvamuktaṃ
māyā vimāyā na ca me kadācit .
sandhyādikaṃ karma kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-18..
verses.colloquial:
samviddhi maam sarva visarva muktam
maayaa vimaayaa na ca me kadaacit .
sandhyaa aadikam karma katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-18..
verses.translation_reworded: Know that I am free from everything, and then again, not free from anything. I have no maya [illusion] and none of its many forms. How can I say I must perform the daily obligatory religious disciplines? By nature I am blissful and free.

verses.sanskrit:
संविद्धि मां सर्वसमाधियुक्तं
संविद्धि मां लक्ष्यविलक्ष्यमुक्तम् ।
योगं वियोगं च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-१९॥
verses.roman:
saṃviddhi māṃ sarvasamādhiyuktaṃ
saṃviddhi māṃ lakṣyavilakṣyamuktam .
yogaṃ viyogaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-19..
verses.colloquial:
samviddhi maam sarva samaadhi yuktam
samviddhi maam lakshya vilakshya muktam .
yogam viyogam ca katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-19..
verses.translation_reworded: Understand that I am wholly immersed in Brahman. Understand that I have neither purpose nor purposelessness. How could I talk about joining or parting? Bliss and freedom are my very nature.

verses.sanskrit:
मूर्खोऽपि नाहं न च पण्डितोऽहं
मौनं विमौनं न च मे कदाचित् ।
तर्कं वितर्कं च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-२०॥
verses.roman:
mūrkho'pi nāhaṃ na ca paṇḍito'haṃ
maunaṃ vimaunaṃ na ca me kadācit .
tarkaṃ vitarkaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-20..
verses.colloquial:
muurkho api na aham na ca pandito aham
maunam vimaunam na ca me kadaacit .
tarkam vitarkam ca katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-20..
verses.translation_reworded: I am not ignorant and I am not learned. I am not silent and I am not a chatterer. How could I set out Brahman through claims and rebuttals? Bliss and freedom are my very nature.

verses.sanskrit:
पिता च माता च कुलं न जाति-
र्जन्मादि मृत्युर्न च मे कदाचित् ।
स्नेहं विमोहं च कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-२१॥
verses.roman:
pitā ca mātā ca kulaṃ na jāti-
rjanmādi mṛtyurna ca me kadācit .
snehaṃ vimohaṃ ca kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-21..
verses.colloquial:
pitaa cha maataa cha kulam na jaati
rjanma aadi mrityur na cha me kadaachit .
sneham vimoham cha katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-21..
verses.translation_reworded: I have no father, no mother, no family, and I belong to no lineage. I was never born and I will never die. How could I say that I feel affection or confusion? Bliss and freedom are my very nature.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्तं गतो नैव सदोदितोऽहं
तेजोवितेजो न च मे कदाचित् ।
सन्ध्यादिकं कर्म कथं वदामि
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-२२॥
verses.roman:
astaṃ gato naiva sadodito'haṃ
tejovitejo na ca me kadācit .
sandhyādikaṃ karma kathaṃ vadāmi
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-22..
verses.colloquial:
astam gato naiva sadodito aham
tejo vitejo na ca me kadaacit .
sandhyaadikam karma katham vadaami
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-22..
verses.translation_reworded: I never vanish; I am always here. In me there is no light and no darkness. How could I say that the rules of ritual apply to me? Bliss and freedom are my very nature.

verses.sanskrit:
असंशयं विद्धि निराकुलं मां
असंशयं विद्धि निरन्तरं माम् ।
असंशयं विद्धि निरञ्जनं मां
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-२३॥
verses.roman:
asaṃśayaṃ viddhi nirākulaṃ māṃ
asaṃśayaṃ viddhi nirantaraṃ mām .
asaṃśayaṃ viddhi nirañjanaṃ māṃ
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-23..
verses.colloquial:
asamshayam viddhi niraakulam maam
asamshayam viddhi nirantaram maam .
asamshayam viddhi niranjanam maam
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-23..
verses.translation_reworded: Be sure of this: I am free of confusion. Be sure of this: I am eternal. Be sure of this: I am without stain. Bliss and freedom are my very nature.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्यानानि सर्वाणि परित्यजन्ति
शुभाशुभं कर्म परित्यजन्ति ।
त्यागामृतं तात पिबन्ति धीराः
स्वरूपनिर्वाणमनामयोऽहम् ॥ ४-२४॥
verses.roman:
dhyānāni sarvāṇi parityajanti
śubhāśubhaṃ karma parityajanti .
tyāgāmṛtaṃ tāta pibanti dhīrāḥ
svarūpanirvāṇamanāmayo'ham ..4-24..
verses.colloquial:
dhyaanaani sarvaani parityajanti
shubha ashubham karma parityajanti .
tyaaga amritam taata pibanti dhiiraah
svaruupa nirvaanam anaamayo aham ..4-24..
verses.translation_reworded: My dear one, the wise abandon every kind of meditation and every kind of action, whether good or bad. They drink the nectar of renunciation. Bliss and freedom are my very nature.

verses.sanskrit:
विन्दति विन्दति न हि न हि यत्र
छन्दोलक्षणं न हि न हि तत्र ।
समरसमग्नो भावितपूतः
प्रलपति तत्त्वं परमवधूतः ॥ ४-२५॥
verses.roman:
vindati vindati na hi na hi yatra
chandolakṣaṇaṃ na hi na hi tatra .
samarasamagno bhāvitapūtaḥ
pralapati tattvaṃ paramavadhūtaḥ ..4-25..
verses.colloquial:
vindati vindati na hi na hi yatra
chando lakshanam na hi na hi tatra .
samarasa magno bhaavita puutah
pralapati tattvam parama avadhuutah ..4-25..
verses.translation_reworded: Where the intellect cannot go, how could any kind of composition exist? The great Avadhuta, having cleansed himself through meditation and merged into Infinite Bliss, has sung of Brahman without premeditation.

verses.sanskrit:
<vt>अथ पञ्चमोऽध्यायः</vt>
ॐ इति गदितं गगनसमं तत्
न परापरसारविचार इति ।
अविलासविलासनिराकरणं
कथमक्षरबिन्दुसमुच्चरणम् ॥ ५-१॥
verses.roman:
<vt>Chapter 5</vt>
oṃ iti gaditaṃ gaganasamaṃ tat
na parāparasāravicāra iti .
avilāsavilāsanirākaraṇaṃ
kathamakṣarabindusamuccaraṇam ..5-1..
verses.colloquial:
<vt>Chapter 5</vt>
om iti gaditam gagana samam tat
na para apara saara vicaara iti .
avilaasa vilaasa niraakaranam
katham akshara bindu samuccaranam ..5-1..
verses.translation_reworded: The all-pervading Brahman has been pointed to by the syllable Om. Yet neither higher nor lower knowledge can fix what It essentially is. In speaking of Brahman, both noumenon and phenomenon have been set aside. So how could the syllable Om express It?

verses.sanskrit:
इति तत्त्वमसिप्रभृतिश्रुतिभिः
प्रतिपादितमात्मनि तत्त्वमसि ।
त्वमुपाधिविवर्जितसर्वसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२॥
verses.roman:
iti tattvamasiprabhṛtiśrutibhiḥ
pratipāditamātmani tattvamasi .
tvamupādhivivarjitasarvasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-2..
verses.colloquial:
iti tattvamasi prabhriti shrutibhih
pratipaaditam aatmani tattvam asi |
tvam upaadhi vivarjita sarva samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-2..
verses.translation_reworded: Through their great sayings such as 'Thou art That' and 'I am Brahman,' the Upanishads have proclaimed that your innermost Atman is the Reality. You are the all-inclusive Sameness, without any attribute. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
अध ऊर्ध्वविवर्जितसर्वसमं
बहिरन्तरवर्जितसर्वसमम् ।
यदि चैकविवर्जितसर्वसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-३॥
verses.roman:
adha ūrdhvavivarjitasarvasamaṃ
bahirantaravarjitasarvasamam .
yadi caikavivarjitasarvasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-3..
verses.colloquial:
adha uurdhva vivarjita sarva samam
bahir antara varjita sarva samam .
yadi ca eka vivarjita sarva samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-3..
verses.translation_reworded: The all-encompassing Brahman has no below and no above, no inside and no outside. Nor can It even be called numerically one. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि कल्पितकल्पविचार इति
न हि कारणकार्यविचार इति ।
पदसन्धिविवर्जितसर्वसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-४॥
verses.roman:
na hi kalpitakalpavicāra iti
na hi kāraṇakāryavicāra iti .
padasandhivivarjitasarvasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-4..
verses.colloquial:
na hi kalpita kalpa vicaara iti
na hi kaarana kaarya vicaara iti .
pada sandhi vivarjita sarva samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-4..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman cannot be perceived by keeping prescribed rules and rites. It cannot be investigated through cause and effect. It is beyond inflected words and euphonic combinations. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि बोधविबोधसमाधिरिति
न हि देशविदेशसमाधिरिति ।
न हि कालविकालसमाधिरिति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-५॥
verses.roman:
na hi bodhavibodhasamādhiriti
na hi deśavideśasamādhiriti .
na hi kālavikālasamādhiriti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-5..
verses.colloquial:
na hi bodha vibodha samaadhir iti
na hi desha videsha samaadhir iti .
na hi kaala vikaala samaadhir iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-5..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is not the joining of consciousness and unconsciousness. It is not the meeting place of space and outer space. It is not the point where time and timelessness merge. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि कुम्भनभो न हि कुम्भ इति
न हि जीववपुर्न हि जीव इति ।
न हि कारणकार्यविभाग इति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-६॥
verses.roman:
na hi kumbhanabho na hi kumbha iti
na hi jīvavapurna hi jīva iti .
na hi kāraṇakāryavibhāga iti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-6..
verses.colloquial:
na hi kumbha nabho na hi kumbha iti
na hi jiiva vapur na hi jiiva iti .
na hi kaarana kaarya vibhaaga iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-6..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is neither the space inside a jar nor the jar. It is neither the body of the individual soul nor the individual soul itself. It lies beyond the relation of cause and effect. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह सर्वनिरन्तरमोक्षपदं
लघुदीर्घविचारविहीन इति ।
न हि वर्तुलकोणविभाग इति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-७॥
verses.roman:
iha sarvanirantaramokṣapadaṃ
laghudīrghavicāravihīna iti .
na hi vartulakoṇavibhāga iti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-7..
verses.colloquial:
iha sarva nirantara moksha padam
laghu diirgha vichaara vihiina iti .
na hi vartula kona vibhaaga iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-7..
verses.translation_reworded: The all-pervading Brahman is freedom Itself. Distinctions of short and long, round and angular, do not exist in It. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह शून्यविशून्यविहीन इति
इह शुद्धविशुद्धविहीन इति ।
इह सर्वविसर्वविहीन इति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-८॥
verses.roman:
iha śūnyaviśūnyavihīna iti
iha śuddhaviśuddhavihīna iti .
iha sarvavisarvavihīna iti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-8..
verses.colloquial:
iha shuunya vishuunya vihiina iti
iha shuddha vishuddha vihiina iti .
iha sarva visarva vihiina iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-8..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is neither empty nor not empty. It is neither pure nor impure. It is neither everything nor nothing. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि भिन्नविभिन्नविचार इति
बहिरन्तरसन्धिविचार इति ।
अरिमित्रविवर्जितसर्वसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-९॥
verses.roman:
na hi bhinnavibhinnavicāra iti
bahirantarasandhivicāra iti .
arimitravivarjitasarvasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-9..
verses.colloquial:
na hi bhinna vibhinna vicaara iti
bahir antar sandhi vicaara iti .
ari mitra vivarjita sarva samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-9..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman cannot be perceived as divided or as undivided. It has no outside, no inside, and no place where the two meet. It is the same toward all and has neither enemy nor friend. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि शिष्यविशिष्यस्वरूप इति
न चराचरभेदविचार इति ।
इह सर्वनिरन्तरमोक्षपदं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-१०॥
verses.roman:
na hi śiṣyaviśiṣyasvarūpa iti
na carācarabhedavicāra iti .
iha sarvanirantaramokṣapadaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-10..
verses.colloquial:
na hi shishya vishishya svaruupa iti
na cara acara bheda vicaara iti .
iha sarva nirantara moksha padam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-10..
verses.translation_reworded: In Brahman there is no difference between someone who is a disciple and someone who is not. In Brahman there is no difference between what moves and what does not. The all-pervading Reality is liberation Itself. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
ननु रूपविरूपविहीन इति
ननु भिन्नविभिन्नविहीन इति ।
ननु सर्गविसर्गविहीन इति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-११॥
verses.roman:
nanu rūpavirūpavihīna iti
nanu bhinnavibhinnavihīna iti .
nanu sargavisargavihīna iti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-11..
verses.colloquial:
nanu ruupa viruupa vihiina iti
nanu bhinna vibhinna vihiina iti .
nanu sarga visarga vihiina iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-11..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is indeed without form and without formlessness. It is truly neither divided nor undivided. It is also free from creation and destruction. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
न गुणागुणपाशनिबन्ध इति
मृतजीवनकर्म करोमि कथम् ।
इति शुद्धनिरञ्जनसर्वसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-१२॥
verses.roman:
na guṇāguṇapāśanibandha iti
mṛtajīvanakarma karomi katham .
iti śuddhanirañjanasarvasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-12..
verses.colloquial:
na guna aguna paasha nibandha iti
mrita jiivana karma karomi katham .
iti shuddha niranjana sarva samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-12..
verses.translation_reworded: Since the chains of good and bad qualities do not bind me, how could I be caught up in the doings of those who live and die? Truly, I am the pure, unclouded, all-pervading Reality. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह भावविभावविहीन इति
इह कामविकामविहीन इति ।
इह बोधतमं खलु मोक्षसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-१३॥
verses.roman:
iha bhāvavibhāvavihīna iti
iha kāmavikāmavihīna iti .
iha bodhatamaṃ khalu mokṣasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-13..
verses.colloquial:
iha bhaava vibhaava vihiina iti
iha kaama vikaama vihiina iti .
iha bodha tamam khalu moksha samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-13..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is free from emotion and agitation, from desire and the absence of desire. This highest Consciousness is indeed one with liberation. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह तत्त्वनिरन्तरतत्त्वमिति
न हि सन्धिविसन्धिविहीन इति ।
यदि सर्वविवर्जितसर्वसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-१४॥
verses.roman:
iha tattvanirantaratattvamiti
na hi sandhivisandhivihīna iti .
yadi sarvavivarjitasarvasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-14..
verses.colloquial:
iha tattva nirantara tattvam iti
na hi sandhi visandhi vihiina iti .
yadi sarva vivarjita sarva samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-14..
verses.translation_reworded: The true nature of Brahman is eternal Reality Itself. It neither unites nor separates. Though It stands apart from everything, It pervades everything equally. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
अनिकेतकुटी परिवारसमं
इहसङ्गविसङ्गविहीनपरम् ।
इह बोधविबोधविहीनपरं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-१५॥
verses.roman:
aniketakuṭī parivārasamaṃ
ihasaṅgavisaṅgavihīnaparam .
iha bodhavibodhavihīnaparaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-15..
verses.colloquial:
aniketa kutii parivaara samam
iha sanga visanga vihiina param .
iha bodha vibodha vihiina param
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-15..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman fills the open space, the house, and the family alike. The Supreme Reality has neither attachment nor detachment, neither knowledge nor ignorance. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
अविकारविकारमसत्यमिति
अविलक्षविलक्षमसत्यमिति ।
यदि केवलमात्मनि सत्यमिति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-१६॥
verses.roman:
avikāravikāramasatyamiti
avilakṣavilakṣamasatyamiti .
yadi kevalamātmani satyamiti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-16..
verses.colloquial:
avikaara vikaaram asatyam iti
avilaksha vilaksham asatyam iti .
yadi kevalam aatmani satyam iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-16..
verses.translation_reworded: This universe, taken as a transformation of the changeless Brahman, is unreal, and every appearance of the unseen Brahman is unreal. The Atman alone is truly the Reality. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह सर्वसमं खलु जीव इति
इह सर्वनिरन्तरजीव इति ।
इह केवलनिश्चलजीव इति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-१७॥
verses.roman:
iha sarvasamaṃ khalu jīva iti
iha sarvanirantarajīva iti .
iha kevalaniścalajīva iti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-17..
verses.colloquial:
iha sarva samam khalu jiiva iti
iha sarva nirantara jiiva iti .
iha kevala nishcala jiiva iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-17..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is truly one and the same as the individual soul. It pervades every living being and every unmoving thing equally. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
अविवेकविवेकमबोध इति
अविकल्पविकल्पमबोध इति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरबोध इति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-१८॥
verses.roman:
avivekavivekamabodha iti
avikalpavikalpamabodha iti .
yadi caikanirantarabodha iti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-18..
verses.colloquial:
aviveka viveka abodha iti
avikalpa vikalpa abodha iti .
yadi ca eka nirantara bodha iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-18..
verses.translation_reworded: It makes no sense to reason about Brahman, which is beyond thought. To see many where there is one is pure ignorance. Brahman is truly unbroken consciousness. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि मोक्षपदं न हि बन्धपदं
न हि पुण्यपदं न हि पापपदम् ।
न हि पूर्णपदं न हि रिक्तपदं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-१९॥
verses.roman:
na hi mokṣapadaṃ na hi bandhapadaṃ
na hi puṇyapadaṃ na hi pāpapadam .
na hi pūrṇapadaṃ na hi riktapadaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-19..
verses.colloquial:
na hi moksha padam na hi bandha padam
na hi punya padam na hi paapa padam .
na hi puurna padam na hi rikta padam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-19..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is not a condition of freedom or of bondage, not a condition of virtue or of vice, not a condition of fullness or of emptiness. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
यदि वर्णविवर्णविहीनसमं
यदि कारणकार्यविहीनसमम् ।
यदिभेदविभेदविहीनसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२०॥
verses.roman:
yadi varṇavivarṇavihīnasamaṃ
yadi kāraṇakāryavihīnasamam .
yadibhedavibhedavihīnasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-20..
verses.colloquial:
yadi varna vivarna vihiina samam
yadi kaarana kaarya vihiina samam .
yadi bheda vibheda vihiina samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-20..
verses.translation_reworded: The omnipresent Brahman has nothing to do with caste or outcaste. It is free from cause and effect, from oneness and manyness. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह सर्वनिरन्तरसर्वचिते
इह केवलनिश्चलसर्वचिते ।
द्विपदादिविवर्जितसर्वचिते
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२१॥
verses.roman:
iha sarvanirantarasarvacite
iha kevalaniścalasarvacite .
dvipadādivivarjitasarvacite
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-21..
verses.colloquial:
iha sarva nirantara sarva cite
iha kevala nishcala sarva cite .
dvipada aadi vivarjita sarva cite
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-21..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman, absolute Consciousness, pervades all living beings and all the motionless things of the world. And yet It shines by Itself, apart from humans and every other being. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
अतिसर्वनिरन्तरसर्वगतं
अतिनिर्मलनिश्चलसर्वगतम् ।
दिनरात्रिविवर्जितसर्वगतं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२२॥
verses.roman:
atisarvanirantarasarvagataṃ
atinirmalaniścalasarvagatam .
dinarātrivivarjitasarvagataṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-22..
verses.colloquial:
ati sarva nirantara sarva gatam
ati nirmala nishchala sarva gatam .
dina raatri vivarjita sarva gatam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-22..
verses.translation_reworded: The omnipresent Brahman is beyond everything, and yet It pervades everything equally. It is utterly pure and still. It exists without day or night. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि बन्धविबन्धसमागमनं
न हि योगवियोगसमागमनम् ।
न हि तर्कवितर्कसमागमनं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२३॥
verses.roman:
na hi bandhavibandhasamāgamanaṃ
na hi yogaviyogasamāgamanam .
na hi tarkavitarkasamāgamanaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-23..
verses.colloquial:
na hi bandha vibandha samaagamanam
na hi yoga viyoga samaagamanam .
na hi tarka vitarka samaagamanam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-23..
verses.translation_reworded: Bondage and freedom, union and separation, reasoning and inference, and similar pairs of opposites never meet in Brahman. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह कालविकालनिराकरणं
अणुमात्रकृशानुनिराकरणम् ।
न हि केवलसत्यनिराकरणं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२४॥
verses.roman:
iha kālavikālanirākaraṇaṃ
aṇumātrakṛśānunirākaraṇam .
na hi kevalasatyanirākaraṇaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-24..
verses.colloquial:
iha kaala vikaala niraakaranam
anu maatra krishaanu niraakaranam .
na hi kevala satya niraakaranam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-24..
verses.translation_reworded: In Brahman, time and its divisions such as morning and evening are all denied. The atom and the primal elements such as fire and air are denied as well. But the Ultimate Reality cannot be denied. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह देहविदेहविहीन इति
ननु स्वप्नसुषुप्तिविहीनपरम् ।
अभिधानविधानविहीनपरं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२५॥
verses.roman:
iha dehavidehavihīna iti
nanu svapnasuṣuptivihīnaparam .
abhidhānavidhānavihīnaparaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-25..
verses.colloquial:
iha deha videha vihiina iti
nanu svapna sushupti vihiina param .
abhidhaana vidhaana vihiina param
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-25..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman neither has a body nor is without one. It has no states such as waking, dreaming, and sleeping. It is beyond names and rules. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
गगनोपमशुद्धविशालसमं
अतिसर्वविवर्जितसर्वसमम् ।
गतसारविसारविकारसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२६॥
verses.roman:
gaganopamaśuddhaviśālasamaṃ
atisarvavivarjitasarvasamam .
gatasāravisāravikārasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-26..
verses.colloquial:
gagana upama shuddha vishaala samam
ati sarva vivarjita sarva samam |
gata saara visaara vikaara samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-26..
verses.translation_reworded: The all-pervading Brahman is stainless and vast like space. It goes beyond everything and It fills everything. It is present in what is essential, in what is not essential, and in every modification. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह धर्मविधर्मविरागतर-
मिह वस्तुविवस्तुविरागतरम् ।
इह कामविकामविरागतरं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२७॥
verses.roman:
iha dharmavidharmavirāgatara-
miha vastuvivastuvirāgataram .
iha kāmavikāmavirāgataraṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-27..
verses.colloquial:
iha dharma vidharma viraagataram
iha vastu vivastu viraagataram .
iha kaama vikaama viraagataram
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-27..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman has no concern with virtue or vice. It is indifferent to wealth and poverty and free from passion and dispassion. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
सुखदुःखविवर्जितसर्वसम-
मिह शोकविशोकविहीनपरम् ।
गुरुशिष्यविवर्जिततत्त्वपरं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२८॥
verses.roman:
sukhaduḥkhavivarjitasarvasama-
miha śokaviśokavihīnaparam .
guruśiṣyavivarjitatattvaparaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-28..
verses.colloquial:
sukha duhkha vivarjita sarva sama
miha shoka vishoka vihiina param .
guru shishya vivarjita tattva param
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-28..
verses.translation_reworded: The all-pervading Brahman is free from pleasure and pain, sorrow and joy. In that Supreme Reality there is neither guru nor disciple. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
न किलाङ्कुरसारविसार इति
न चलाचलसाम्यविसाम्यमिति ।
अविचारविचारविहीनमिति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-२९॥
verses.roman:
na kilāṅkurasāravisāra iti
na calācalasāmyavisāmyamiti .
avicāravicāravihīnamiti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-29..
verses.colloquial:
na kilaankura saara visaara iti
na calaacala saamya visaamyam iti .
avicaara vicaara vihiinam iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-29..
verses.translation_reworded: In Brahman there is no love-play and no offspring, no strength and no weakness. It has neither motion nor stillness, neither equality nor inequality. It is without discrimination and without the lack of it. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
इह सारसमुच्चयसारमिति ।
कथितं निजभावविभेद इति ।
विषये करणत्वमसत्यमिति
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-३०॥
verses.roman:
iha sārasamuccayasāramiti .
kathitaṃ nijabhāvavibheda iti .
viṣaye karaṇatvamasatyamiti
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-30..
verses.colloquial:
iha saara samuccaya saaram iti .
kathitam nija bhaava vibheda iti .
vishaye karanatvam asatyam iti
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-30..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is the essence of all essences, and Its nature [attributes] has been described as something apart from Itself. Any action within the world of the senses is unreal. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
बहुधा श्रुतयः प्रवदन्ति यतो
वियदादिरिदं मृगतोयसमम् ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वसमं
किमु रोदिषि मानसि सर्वसमम् ॥ ५-३१॥
verses.roman:
bahudhā śrutayaḥ pravadanti yato
viyadādiridaṃ mṛgatoyasamam .
yadi caikanirantarasarvasamaṃ
kimu rodiṣi mānasi sarvasamam ..5-31..
verses.colloquial:
bahudhaa shrutayah pravadanti yato
viyad aadir idam mriga toya samam .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva samam
kimu rodishi maanasi sarva samam ..5-31..
verses.translation_reworded: In many ways the Upanishads state that manifested space, earth, and the rest are like water in a mirage. In truth, Brahman alone exists equally in everything. You are that very Brahman, O mind, so why do you weep?

verses.sanskrit:
विन्दति विन्दति न हि न हि यत्र
छन्दोलक्षणं न हि न हि तत्र ।
समरसमग्नो भावितपूतः
प्रलपति तत्त्वं परमवधूतः ॥ ५-३२॥
verses.roman:
vindati vindati na hi na hi yatra
chandolakṣaṇaṃ na hi na hi tatra .
samarasamagno bhāvitapūtaḥ
pralapati tattvaṃ paramavadhūtaḥ ..5-32..
verses.colloquial:
vindati vindati na hi na hi yatra
chando lakshanam na hi na hi tatra .
samarasa magno bhaavita puutah
pralapati tattvam parama vadhuutah ..5-32..
verses.translation_reworded: Where the intellect cannot go, how could any kind of composition exist? The great Avadhuta, having cleansed himself through meditation and merged into Infinite Bliss, has sung of Brahman without premeditation.

verses.sanskrit:
<vt>अथ षष्ठमोऽध्यायः</vt>
बहुधा श्रुतयः प्रवदन्ति वयं
वियदादिरिदं मृगतोयसमम् ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिव-
मुपमेयमथोह्युपमा च कथम् ॥ ६-१॥
verses.roman:
<vt>Chapter 6</vt>
bahudhā śrutayaḥ pravadanti vayaṃ
viyadādiridaṃ mṛgatoyasamam .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśiva-
mupameyamathohyupamā ca katham ..6-1..
verses.colloquial:
<vt>Chapter 6</vt>
bahudhaa shrutayah pravadanti vayam
viyad aadir idam mriga toya samam .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
upameyam atho hi upamaa ca katham ..6-1..
verses.translation_reworded: The Upanishads tell us in many ways that space, earth, and the rest are like water in a mirage. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how could It be compared with anything or have an equal?

verses.sanskrit:
अविभक्तिविभक्तिविहीनपरं
ननु कार्यविकार्यविहीनपरम् ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
यजनं च कथं तपनं च कथम् ॥ ६-२॥
verses.roman:
avibhaktivibhaktivihīnaparaṃ
nanu kāryavikāryavihīnaparam .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
yajanaṃ ca kathaṃ tapanaṃ ca katham ..6-2..
verses.colloquial:
avibhakti vibhakti vihiina param
nanu kaarya vikaarya vihiina param .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
yajanam ca katham tapanam ca katham ..6-2..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is neither divided nor undivided. It is truly free from action and change. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, where is there room for worship and austerity?

verses.sanskrit:
मन एव निरन्तरसर्वगतं
ह्यविशालविशालविहीनपरम् ।
मन एव निरन्तरसर्वशिवं
मनसापि कथं वचसा च कथम् ॥ ६-३॥
verses.roman:
mana eva nirantarasarvagataṃ
hyaviśālaviśālavihīnaparam .
mana eva nirantarasarvaśivaṃ
manasāpi kathaṃ vacasā ca katham ..6-3..
verses.colloquial:
mana eva nirantara sarva gatam
hy avishaala vishaala vihiina param .
mana eva nirantara sarva shivam
manasaapi katham vacasaa ca katham ..6-3..
verses.translation_reworded: That Intelligence is truly eternal and omnipresent, and neither vast nor minute. If that Intelligence is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can the mind grasp It or speech express It?

verses.sanskrit:
दिनरात्रिविभेदनिराकरण-
मुदितानुदितस्य निराकरणम् ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
रविचन्द्रमसौ ज्वलनश्च कथम् ॥ ६-४॥
verses.roman:
dinarātrivibhedanirākaraṇa-
muditānuditasya nirākaraṇam .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
ravicandramasau jvalanaśca katham ..6-4..
verses.colloquial:
dina raatri vibheda niraakarana
mudita anuditasya niraakaranam .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
ravi candramasau jvalanash ca katham ..6-4..
verses.translation_reworded: In the self-luminous Brahman there is no division into day and night, sunrise and sunset. If It alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how could the sun, the moon, or fire light It up?

verses.sanskrit:
गतकामविकामविभेद इति
गतचेष्टविचेष्टविभेद इति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
बहिरन्तरभिन्नमतिश्च कथम् ॥ ६-५॥
verses.roman:
gatakāmavikāmavibheda iti
gataceṣṭaviceṣṭavibheda iti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
bahirantarabhinnamatiśca katham ..6-5..
verses.colloquial:
gata kaama vikaama vibheda iti
gata cesht avicesht vibheda iti .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
bahir antara bhinna matish ca katham ..6-5..
verses.translation_reworded: The distinctions of desire and desirelessness, action and inaction, are wholly absent from Brahman. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can there be any idea of outside and inside?

verses.sanskrit:
यदि सारविसारविहीन इति
यदि शून्यविशून्यविहीन इति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
प्रथमं च कथं चरमं च कथम् ॥ ६-६॥
verses.roman:
yadi sāravisāravihīna iti
yadi śūnyaviśūnyavihīna iti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
prathamaṃ ca kathaṃ caramaṃ ca katham ..6-6..
verses.colloquial:
yadi saara visaara vihiina iti
yadi shuunya vishuunya vihiina iti .
yadi caika nirantara sarva shivam
prathamam ca katham caramam ca katham ..6-6..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman has no expansion or contraction, no fullness or emptiness. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, where could a first or a last be placed?

verses.sanskrit:
यदिभेदविभेदनिराकरणं
यदि वेदकवेद्यनिराकरणम् ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
तृतीयं च कथं तुरीयं च कथम् ॥ ६-७॥
verses.roman:
yadibhedavibhedanirākaraṇaṃ
yadi vedakavedyanirākaraṇam .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
tṛtīyaṃ ca kathaṃ turīyaṃ ca katham ..6-7..
verses.colloquial:
yadi bheda vibheda niraakaranam
yadi veda ka vedya niraakaranam .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
tritiiyam ca katham turiiyam ca katham ..6-7..
verses.translation_reworded: For Brahman, the notions of difference and sameness, knower and known, are rejected. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can there be a third state [sleep] or a Fourth [the Transcendental]?

verses.sanskrit:
गदिताविदितं न हि सत्यमिति
विदिताविदितं न हि सत्यमिति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
विषयेन्द्रियबुद्धिमनांसि कथम् ॥ ६-८॥
verses.roman:
gaditāviditaṃ na hi satyamiti
viditāviditaṃ na hi satyamiti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
viṣayendriyabuddhimanāṃsi katham ..6-8..
verses.colloquial:
gaditaaviditam na hi satyam iti
viditaaviditam na hi satyam iti .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
vishaya indriya buddhi manaamsi katham ..6-8..
verses.translation_reworded: To regard Brahman as expressible or inexpressible, knowable or unknowable, is pure fancy. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can there be objects, senses, mind, and intellect?

verses.sanskrit:
गगनं पवनो न हि सत्यमिति
धरणी दहनो न हि सत्यमिति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
जलदश्च कथं सलिलं च कथम् ॥ ६-९॥
verses.roman:
gaganaṃ pavano na hi satyamiti
dharaṇī dahano na hi satyamiti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
jaladaśca kathaṃ salilaṃ ca katham ..6-9..
verses.colloquial:
gaganam pavano na hi satyam iti
dharanii dahano na hi satyam iti .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
jaladash ca katham salilam ca katham ..6-9..
verses.translation_reworded: Neither space nor air has reality, neither fire nor earth, neither water nor clouds. Only the undivided Supreme Bliss is real.

verses.sanskrit:
यदि कल्पितलोकनिराकरणं
यदि कल्पितदेवनिराकरणम् ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
गुणदोषविचारमतिश्च कथम् ॥ ६-१०॥
verses.roman:
yadi kalpitalokanirākaraṇaṃ
yadi kalpitadevanirākaraṇam .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
guṇadoṣavicāramatiśca katham ..6-10..
verses.colloquial:
yadi kalpita loka niraakaranam
yadi kalpita deva niraakaranam .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
guna dosha vicaara mati cha katham ..6-10..
verses.translation_reworded: Because the various worlds [earth, heaven, and so on] and the gods [Vishnu, Shiva, Brahma, and so on] are nothing but imagination, their existence has been denied. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can there be merit or demerit, reasoning or intellect?

verses.sanskrit:
मरणामरणं हि निराकरणं
करणाकरणं हि निराकरणम् ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
गमनागमनं हि कथं वदति ॥ ६-११॥
verses.roman:
maraṇāmaraṇaṃ hi nirākaraṇaṃ
karaṇākaraṇaṃ hi nirākaraṇam .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
gamanāgamanaṃ hi kathaṃ vadati ..6-11..
verses.colloquial:
maranaa maranam hi niraakaranam
karanaa karanam hi niraakaranam .
yadi cha eka nirantara sarva shivam
gamanaa gamanam hi katham vadati ..6-11..
verses.translation_reworded: In Brahman there is no death and no immortality, no action and no inaction. If Brahman alone is the all-pervading Supreme Bliss, how can anyone speak of Its coming or going?

verses.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिः पुरुषो न हि भेद इति
न हि कारणकार्यविभेद इति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
पुरुषापुरुषं च कथं वदति ॥ ६-१२॥
verses.roman:
prakṛtiḥ puruṣo na hi bheda iti
na hi kāraṇakāryavibheda iti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
puruṣāpuruṣaṃ ca kathaṃ vadati ..6-12..
verses.colloquial:
prakriti purusho na hi bheda iti
na hi kaarana kaarya vibheda iti .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
purusha apurusham ca katham vadati ..6-12..
verses.translation_reworded: In Brahman there is no distinction between Purusha [Spirit] and prakriti [matter], and no cause and effect. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can anyone call It male or female?

verses.sanskrit:
तृतीयं न हि दुःखसमागमनं
न गुणाद्द्वितीयस्य समागमनम् ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
स्थविरश्च युवा च शिशुश्च कथम् ॥ ६-१३॥
verses.roman:
tṛtīyaṃ na hi duḥkhasamāgamanaṃ
na guṇāddvitīyasya samāgamanam .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
sthaviraśca yuvā ca śiśuśca katham ..6-13..
verses.colloquial:
tritiiyam na hi duhkha samaagamanam
na gunaad dvitiiyasya samaagamanam .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
sthavirash ca yuvaa ca shishush ca katham ..6-13..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman has no connection with the miseries of old age or the pleasures of youth. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can there be childhood, youth, or old age?

verses.sanskrit:
ननु आश्रमवर्णविहीनपरं
ननु कारणकर्तृविहीनपरम् ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिव-
मविनष्टविनष्टमतिश्च कथम् ॥ ६-१४॥
verses.roman:
nanu āśramavarṇavihīnaparaṃ
nanu kāraṇakartṛvihīnaparam .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśiva-
mavinaṣṭavinaṣṭamatiśca katham ..6-14..
verses.colloquial:
nanu aashrama varna vihiina param
nanu kaarana kartri vihiina param .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shiva
avinashta vinashta mati cha katham ..6-14..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is indeed free of the four stages of life and the four castes. It has no cause and It is not a doer. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can one think of It as perishable or as imperishable?

verses.sanskrit:
ग्रसिताग्रसितं च वितथ्यमिति
जनिताजनितं च वितथ्यमिति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिव-
मविनाशि विनाशि कथं हि भवेत् ॥ ६-१५॥
verses.roman:
grasitāgrasitaṃ ca vitathyamiti
janitājanitaṃ ca vitathyamiti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśiva-
mavināśi vināśi kathaṃ hi bhavet ..6-15..
verses.colloquial:
grasita agrasitam ca vitathyam iti
janita ajanitam ca vitathyam iti .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shiva
avinaashi vinaashi katham hi bhavet ..6-15..
verses.translation_reworded: To think that Brahman is bound or freed, created or uncreated, is pure fancy. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can It be either mortal or immortal?

verses.sanskrit:
पुरुषापुरुषस्य विनष्टमिति
वनितावनितस्य विनष्टमिति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिव-
मविनोदविनोदमतिश्च कथम् ॥ ६-१६॥
verses.roman:
puruṣāpuruṣasya vinaṣṭamiti
vanitāvanitasya vinaṣṭamiti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśiva-
mavinodavinodamatiśca katham ..6-16..
verses.colloquial:
purushaa purushasya vinashtam iti
vanitaa vanitasya vinashtam iti .
yadi caika nirantara sarva shiva
avinoda vinoda matish ca katham ..6-16..
verses.translation_reworded: The ideas of man and woman, wife and husband, do not exist in Brahman. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can one feel pain and pleasure?

verses.sanskrit:
यदि मोहविषादविहीनपरो
यदि संशयशोकविहीनपरः ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिव-
महमत्र ममेति कथं च पुनः ॥ ६-१७॥
verses.roman:
yadi mohaviṣādavihīnaparo
yadi saṃśayaśokavihīnaparaḥ .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśiva-
mahamatra mameti kathaṃ ca punaḥ ..6-17..
verses.colloquial:
yadi moha vishaada vihiina paro
yadi samshaya shoka vihiina parah .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shiva
maham atra mama iti katham ca punah ..6-17..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is indeed free from delusion and dejection, doubt and distress. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can there be 'I' and 'mine'?

verses.sanskrit:
महमेति
ननु धर्मविधर्मविनाश इति
ननु बन्धविबन्धविनाश इति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं-
मिहदुःखविदुःखमतिश्च कथम् ॥ ६-१८॥
verses.roman:
mahameti
nanu dharmavidharmavināśa iti
nanu bandhavibandhavināśa iti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ-
mihaduḥkhaviduḥkhamatiśca katham ..6-18..
verses.colloquial:
mahaam eti
nanu dharma vidharma vinaasha iti
nanu bandha vibandha vinaasha iti .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
miha duhkha viduhkham atish ca katham ..6-18..
verses.translation_reworded: The distinctions of merit and demerit, bondage and freedom, are truly cancelled in Brahman. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can there be feelings of misery and happiness?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि याज्ञिकयज्ञविभाग इति
न हुताशनवस्तुविभाग इति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
वद कर्मफलानि भवन्ति कथम् ॥ ६-१९॥
verses.roman:
na hi yājñikayajñavibhāga iti
na hutāśanavastuvibhāga iti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
vada karmaphalāni bhavanti katham ..6-19..
verses.colloquial:
na hi yaajnika yajna vibhaaga iti
na hutaashana vastu vibhaaga iti .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
vada karma phalaani bhavanti katham ..6-19..
verses.translation_reworded: In Brahman there is no difference between the one who sacrifices and the sacrifice, or between the sacrificial fire and the offering. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, tell me, how can there be any fruits of action?

verses.sanskrit:
ननु शोकविशोकविमुक्त इति
ननु दर्पविदर्पविमुक्त इति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
ननु रागविरागमतिश्च कथम् ॥ ६-२०॥
verses.roman:
nanu śokaviśokavimukta iti
nanu darpavidarpavimukta iti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
nanu rāgavirāgamatiśca katham ..6-20..
verses.colloquial:
nanu shoka vishoka vimukta iti
nanu darpa vidarpa vimukta iti .
yadi ca eka nirantara sarva shivam
nanu raaga viraaga matish ca katham ..6-20..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman is indeed free from sorrow and joy, pride and humility. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can there be any thought of passion or dispassion?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि मोहविमोहविकार इति
न हि लोभविलोभविकार इति ।
यदि चैकनिरन्तरसर्वशिवं
ह्यविवेकविवेकमतिश्च कथम् ॥ ६-२१॥
verses.roman:
na hi mohavimohavikāra iti
na hi lobhavilobhavikāra iti .
yadi caikanirantarasarvaśivaṃ
hyavivekavivekamatiśca katham ..6-21..
verses.colloquial:
na hi moha vimoha vikaara iti
na hi lobha vilobha vikaara iti .
yadi cai eka nirantara sarva shivam
hi avivek aviveka mati cha katham ..6-21..
verses.translation_reworded: Infatuation and temptation, greed and delusion, cannot disturb or alter Brahman. If Brahman alone is the undivided Supreme Bliss, how can there be any thought of discrimination or its absence?

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमहं न हि हन्त कदाचिदपि
कुलजातिविचारमसत्यमिति ।
अहमेव शिवः परमार्थ इति
अभिवादनमत्र करोमि कथम् ॥ ६-२२॥
verses.roman:
tvamahaṃ na hi hanta kadācidapi
kulajātivicāramasatyamiti .
ahameva śivaḥ paramārtha iti
abhivādanamatra karomi katham ..6-22..
verses.colloquial:
tvam aham na hi hanta kadaacid api
kula jaati vicaaram asatyam iti .
aham eva shivah paramaartha iti
abhivaadanam atra karomi katham ..6-22..
verses.translation_reworded: See this: neither "you" nor "I" has ever existed. To think of yourself as belonging to a family or a caste is utter nonsense. I truly am Brahman, the Supreme Reality. So how could I bow down to It?

verses.sanskrit:
गुरुशिष्यविचारविशीर्ण इति
उपदेशविचारविशीर्ण इति ।
अहमेव शिवः परमार्थ इति
अभिवादनमत्र करोमि कथम् ॥ ६-२३॥
verses.roman:
guruśiṣyavicāraviśīrṇa iti
upadeśavicāraviśīrṇa iti .
ahameva śivaḥ paramārtha iti
abhivādanamatra karomi katham ..6-23..
verses.colloquial:
guru shishya vicaara vishiirna iti
upadesha vicaara vishiirna iti .
aham eva shivah paramaartha iti
abhivaadanam atra karomi katham ..6-23..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman holds no distinction at all between guru and disciple, or between teaching and reflection. I truly am Brahman, the Supreme Reality. So how could I bow down to It?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि कल्पितदेहविभाग इति
न हि कल्पितलोकविभाग इति ।
अहमेव शिवः परमार्थ इति
अभिवादनमत्र करोमि कथम् ॥ ६-२४॥
verses.roman:
na hi kalpitadehavibhāga iti
na hi kalpitalokavibhāga iti .
ahameva śivaḥ paramārtha iti
abhivādanamatra karomi katham ..6-24..
verses.colloquial:
na hi kalpita deha vibhaaga iti
na hi kalpita loka vibhaaga iti .
aham eva shivah paramaartha iti
abhivaadanam atra karomi katham ..6-24..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman has no divisions into physical forms or into imagined worlds. I truly am Brahman, the Supreme Reality. So how could I bow down to It?

verses.sanskrit:
सरजो विरजो न कदाचिदपि
ननु निर्मलनिश्चलशुद्ध इति ।
अहमेव शिवः परमार्थ इति
अभिवादनमत्र करोमि कथम् ॥ ६-२५॥
verses.roman:
sarajo virajo na kadācidapi
nanu nirmalaniścalaśuddha iti .
ahameva śivaḥ paramārtha iti
abhivādanamatra karomi katham ..6-25..
verses.colloquial:
sarajo virajo na kadaacid api
nanu nirmala nishcala shuddha iti .
aham eva shivah paramaartha iti
abhivaadanam atra karomi katham ..6-25..
verses.translation_reworded: Passion and dispassion have no place whatsoever in Brahman. It is radiant, unmoving and pure. I truly am Brahman, the Supreme Reality. So how could I bow down to It?

verses.sanskrit:
न हि देहविदेहविकल्प इति
अनृतं चरितं न हि सत्यमिति ।
अहमेव शिवः परमार्थ इति
अभिवादनमत्र करोमि कथम् ॥ ६-२६॥
verses.roman:
na hi dehavidehavikalpa iti
anṛtaṃ caritaṃ na hi satyamiti .
ahameva śivaḥ paramārtha iti
abhivādanamatra karomi katham ..6-26..
verses.colloquial:
na hi deha videha vikalpa iti
anritam caritam na hi satyam iti .
aham eva shivah paramaartha iti
abhivaadanam atra karomi katham ..6-26..
verses.translation_reworded: The idea that Brahman has a body, or that It has none, is pure imagination. The actions that life appears to involve are unreal as well. I truly am Brahman, the Supreme Reality. So how could I bow down to It?

verses.sanskrit:
विन्दति विन्दति न हि न हि यत्र
छन्दोलक्षणं न हि न हि तत्र ।
समरसमग्नो भावितपूतः
प्रलपति तत्त्वं परमवधूतः ॥ ६-२७॥
verses.roman:
vindati vindati na hi na hi yatra
chandolakṣaṇaṃ na hi na hi tatra .
samarasamagno bhāvitapūtaḥ
pralapati tattvaṃ paramavadhūtaḥ ..6-27..
verses.colloquial:
vindati vindati na hi na hi yatra
chando lakshanam na hi na hi tatra .
samarasa magno bhaavita puutah
pralapati tattvam parama avadhuutah ..6-27..
verses.translation_reworded: How can anything be composed about what the intellect cannot reach? Having purified himself through meditation and merged in Infinite Bliss, the great Avadhuta has sung of Brahman spontaneously.

verses.sanskrit:
