<vt>अथ सप्तमोऽध्यायः</vt>
रथ्याकर्पटविरचितकन्थः
पुण्यापुण्यविवर्जितपन्थः ।
शून्यागारे तिष्ठति नग्नो
शुद्धनिरञ्जनसमरसमग्नः ॥ ७-१॥
verses.roman:
<vt>Chapter 7</vt>
rathyākarpaṭaviracitakanthaḥ
puṇyāpuṇyavivarjitapanthaḥ .
śūnyāgāre tiṣṭhati nagno
śuddhanirañjanasamarasamagnaḥ ..7-1..
verses.colloquial:
<vt>Chapter 7</vt>
rathyaa karpata viracita kanthah
punya apunya vivarjita panthah .
shuunya agaare tishthati nagno
shuddha niranjana samarasa magnah ..7-1..
verses.translation_reworded: The Avadhuta's patched garment is sewn from rags thrown away beside the road. The path he walks lies beyond virtue and vice. Carefree, this mendicant makes his home in a deserted place, immersed in the pure, untainted bliss of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
लक्ष्यालक्ष्यविवर्जितलक्ष्यो
युक्तायुक्तविवर्जितदक्षः ।
केवलतत्त्वनिरञ्जनपूतो
वादविवादः कथमवधूतः ॥ ७-२॥
verses.roman:
lakṣyālakṣyavivarjitalakṣyo
yuktāyuktavivarjitadakṣaḥ .
kevalatattvanirañjanapūto
vādavivādaḥ kathamavadhūtaḥ ..7-2..
verses.colloquial:
lakshya alakshya vivarjita lakshyo
yukta ayukta vivarjita dakshah .
kevala tattva niranjana puuto
vaada vivaadah katham avadhuutah ..7-2..
verses.translation_reworded: The marks of the Avadhuta may show or they may not. He stands beyond right and wrong, yet he is completely honest. His true nature is perfect, pure and without blemish. How could so illumined a soul get caught up in arguments and debates?

verses.sanskrit:
आशापाशविबन्धनमुक्ताः
शौचाचारविवर्जितयुक्ताः ।
एवं सर्वविवर्जितशान्ता-
स्तत्त्वं शुद्धनिरञ्जनवन्तः ॥ ७-३॥
verses.roman:
āśāpāśavibandhanamuktāḥ
śaucācāravivarjitayuktāḥ .
evaṃ sarvavivarjitaśāntā-
stattvaṃ śuddhanirañjanavantaḥ ..7-3..
verses.colloquial:
aashaa paasha vibandhana muktaah
shauca aacaara vivarjita yuktaah .
evam sarva vivarjita shaantaa
stattvam shuddha niranjanavantah ..7-3..
verses.translation_reworded: The alluring trap of desire no longer holds the Avadhuta. Turning away from physical neatness and social courtesies, he stays immersed in the Supreme Spirit. Having given up everything in this way, he becomes one with pure, stainless Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
कथमिह देहविदेहविचारः
कथमिह रागविरागविचारः ।
निर्मलनिश्चलगगनाकारं
स्वयमिह तत्त्वं सहजाकारम् ॥ ७-४॥
verses.roman:
kathamiha dehavidehavicāraḥ
kathamiha rāgavirāgavicāraḥ .
nirmalaniścalagaganākāraṃ
svayamiha tattvaṃ sahajākāram ..7-4..
verses.colloquial:
katham iha deha videha vicaarah
katham iha raaga viraaga vicaarah .
nirmala nishchala gaganaakaaram
svayam iha tattvam sahajaakaaram ..7-4..
verses.translation_reworded: In this state of realization, how could the Avadhuta even ask whether he has a body or not, or whether he is attached or not? He is himself the innate Reality, spotless and unmoving, as infinite as space.

verses.sanskrit:
कथमिह तत्त्वं विन्दति यत्र
रूपमरूपं कथमिह तत्र ।
गगनाकारः परमो यत्र
विषयीकरणं कथमिह तत्र ॥ ७-५॥
verses.roman:
kathamiha tattvaṃ vindati yatra
rūpamarūpaṃ kathamiha tatra .
gaganākāraḥ paramo yatra
viṣayīkaraṇaṃ kathamiha tatra ..7-5..
verses.colloquial:
katham iha tattvam vindati yatra
ruupam aruupam katham iha tatra .
gagana aakaarah paramo yatra
vishayii karanam katham iha tatra ..7-5..
verses.translation_reworded: In this state of realization, how could anyone know the Reality, and where? How can there be form or formlessness? If the Supreme Reality pervades everything as space does, how could anyone make It an object?

verses.sanskrit:
गगनाकारनिरन्तरहंस-
स्तत्त्वविशुद्धनिरञ्जनहंसः ।
एवं कथमिह भिन्नविभिन्नं
बन्धविबन्धविकारविभिन्नम् ॥ ७-६॥
verses.roman:
gaganākāranirantarahaṃsa-
stattvaviśuddhanirañjanahaṃsaḥ .
evaṃ kathamiha bhinnavibhinnaṃ
bandhavibandhavikāravibhinnam ..7-6..
verses.colloquial:
gagana aakaara nirantara hamsah
tattva vishuddha niranjana hamsah .
evam katham iha bhinna vibhinnam
bandha vibandha vikaara vibhinnam ..7-6..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman pervades everything as space does, and Its very nature is pure and spotless. So how could It contain division and multiplication, bondage and liberation, or any other change?

verses.sanskrit:
केवलतत्त्वनिरन्तरसर्वं
योगवियोगौ कथमिह गर्वम् ।
एवं परमनिरन्तरसर्व-
मेवं कथमिह सारविसारम् ॥ ७-७॥
verses.roman:
kevalatattvanirantarasarvaṃ
yogaviyogau kathamiha garvam .
evaṃ paramanirantarasarva-
mevaṃ kathamiha sāravisāram ..7-7..
verses.colloquial:
kevala tattva nirantara sarvam
yoga viyogau katham iha garvam .
evam parama nirantara sarvam
evam katham iha saara visaaram ..7-7..
verses.translation_reworded: The Absolute Brahman pervades everything equally. How could anyone experience union or separation there? Since the Supreme Brahman is the same in all, how could It vary in strength or weakness?

verses.sanskrit:
केवलतत्त्वनिरञ्जनसर्वं
गगनाकारनिरन्तरशुद्धम् ।
एवं कथमिह सङ्गविसङ्गं
सत्यं कथमिह रङ्गविरङ्गम् ॥ ७-८॥
verses.roman:
kevalatattvanirañjanasarvaṃ
gaganākāranirantaraśuddham .
evaṃ kathamiha saṅgavisaṅgaṃ
satyaṃ kathamiha raṅgaviraṅgam ..7-8..
verses.colloquial:
kevala tattva niranjana sarvam
gagana aakaara nirantara shuddham .
evam katham iha sanga visangam
satyam katham iha ranga virangam ..7-8..
verses.translation_reworded: The Absolute Brahman shines equally in everything, clear and all-pervading like space. How could friendship or hostility, joy or sorrow, really exist in It?

verses.sanskrit:
योगवियोगै रहितो योगी
भोगविभोगै रहितो भोगी ।
एवं चरति हि मन्दं मन्दं
मनसा कल्पितसहजानन्दम् ॥ ७-९॥
verses.roman:
yogaviyogai rahito yogī
bhogavibhogai rahito bhogī .
evaṃ carati hi mandaṃ mandaṃ
manasā kalpitasahajānandam ..7-9..
verses.colloquial:
yoga viyogai rahito yogii
bhoga vibhogai rahito bhogii .
evam carati hi mandam mandam
manasaa kalpita sahaja aanandam ..7-9..
verses.translation_reworded: Whether or not the Avadhuta follows the rules of yoga, he is still a yogi. Whether or not he owns anything, he is still an enjoyer. He moves slowly and calmly, delighting in the natural bliss that rises from his own pure mind.

verses.sanskrit:
बोधविबोधैः सततं युक्तो
द्वैताद्वैतैः कथमिह मुक्तः ।
सहजो विरजः कथमिह योगी
शुद्धनिरञ्जनसमरसभोगी ॥ ७-१०॥
verses.roman:
bodhavibodhaiḥ satataṃ yukto
dvaitādvaitaiḥ kathamiha muktaḥ .
sahajo virajaḥ kathamiha yogī
śuddhanirañjanasamarasabhogī ..7-10..
verses.colloquial:
bodha vibodhaih satatam yukto
dvaita advaitaih katham iha muktah .
sahajo virajah katham iha yogii
shuddha niranjana samarasa bhogii ..7-10..
verses.translation_reworded: So long as someone holds both knowledge and ignorance, along with a sense of duality and non-duality, how can he be liberated? And why would anyone try to become a yogi who constantly enjoys the pure, unmixed bliss of Brahman, and whose inborn nature has no desire or ignorance?

verses.sanskrit:
भग्नाभग्नविवर्जितभग्नो
लग्नालग्नविवर्जितलग्नः ।
एवं कथमिह सारविसारः
समरसतत्त्वं गगनाकारः ॥ ७-११॥
verses.roman:
bhagnābhagnavivarjitabhagno
lagnālagnavivarjitalagnaḥ .
evaṃ kathamiha sāravisāraḥ
samarasatattvaṃ gaganākāraḥ ..7-11..
verses.colloquial:
bhagna abhagna vivarjita bhagno
lagna alagna vivarjita lagnah .
evam katham iha saara visaarah
samarasa tattvam gagana aakaarah ..7-11..
verses.translation_reworded: Brahman has no division, since It is beyond whole and part. It clings to nothing, since It is beyond attachment and non-attachment. As It is all-pervading existence, like space, how could It contract or expand?

verses.sanskrit:
सततं सर्वविवर्जितयुक्तः
सर्वं तत्त्वविवर्जितमुक्तः ।
एवं कथमिह जीवितमरणं
ध्यानाध्यानैः कथमिह करणम् ॥ ७-१२॥
verses.roman:
satataṃ sarvavivarjitayuktaḥ
sarvaṃ tattvavivarjitamuktaḥ .
evaṃ kathamiha jīvitamaraṇaṃ
dhyānādhyānaiḥ kathamiha karaṇam ..7-12..
verses.colloquial:
satatam sarva vivarjita yuktah
sarvam tattva vivarjita muktah .
evam katham iha jiivita maranam
dhyaana adhyaanaih katham iha karanam ..7-12..
verses.translation_reworded: Having given up everything, the Avadhuta remains forever united with Brahman. He has gone beyond all the elements and is free. How could life or death apply to him? What difference does it make whether he meditates or not?

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रजालमिदं सर्वं यथा मरुमरीचिका ।
अखण्डितमनाकारो वर्तते केवलः शिवः ॥ ७-१३॥
verses.roman:
indrajālamidaṃ sarvaṃ yathā marumarīcikā .
akhaṇḍitamanākāro vartate kevalaḥ śivaḥ ..7-13..
verses.colloquial:
indrajaalam idam sarvam yathaa maru mariicikaa |
akhanditam anaakaaro vartate kevalah shivah ..7-13..
verses.translation_reworded: This entire world is an illusion, like a mirage in the desert. Only the indivisible, formless Supreme Beatitude exists.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मादौ मोक्षपर्यन्तं निरीहाः सर्वथा वयम् ।
कथं रागविरागैश्च कल्पयन्ति विपश्चितः ॥ ७-१४॥
verses.roman:
dharmādau mokṣaparyantaṃ nirīhāḥ sarvathā vayam .
kathaṃ rāgavirāgaiśca kalpayanti vipaścitaḥ ..7-14..
verses.colloquial:
dharma aadau moksha paryantam niriihaah sarvathaa vayam .
katham raaga viraagaish ca kalpayanti vipashcitah ..7-14..
verses.translation_reworded: We Avadhutas never seek righteousness, wealth, enjoyment or liberation. So how can scholars suppose that we have either attachment or detachment?

verses.sanskrit:
विन्दति विन्दति न हि न हि यत्र
छन्दोलक्षणं न हि न हि तत्र ।
समरसमग्नो भावितपूतः
प्रलपति तत्त्वं परमवधूतः ॥ ७-१५॥
verses.roman:
vindati vindati na hi na hi yatra
chandolakṣaṇaṃ na hi na hi tatra .
samarasamagno bhāvitapūtaḥ
pralapati tattvaṃ paramavadhūtaḥ ..7-15..
verses.colloquial:
vindati vindati na hi na hi yatra
chando lakshanam na hi na hi tatra .
samarasa magno bhaavita puutah
pralapati tattvam parama avadhuutah ..7-15..
verses.translation_reworded: How can anything be composed about what the intellect cannot reach? Having purified himself through meditation and merged in Infinite Bliss, the great Avadhuta has sung of Brahman spontaneously.

verses.sanskrit:
<vt>अथ अष्टमोऽध्यायः</vt>
त्वद्यात्रया व्यापकता हता ते
ध्यानेन चेतःपरता हता ते ।
स्तुत्या मया वाक्परता हता ते
क्षमस्व नित्यं त्रिविधापराधान् ॥ ८-१॥
verses.roman:
<vt>Chapter 8</vt>
tvadyātrayā vyāpakatā hatā te
dhyānena cetaḥparatā hatā te .
stutyā mayā vākparatā hatā te
kṣamasva nityaṃ trividhāparādhān ..8-1..
verses.colloquial:
<vt>Chapter 8</vt>
tvad yaatrayaa vyaapakataa hataa te
dhyaanena cetah parataa hataa te .
stutyaa mayaa vaak parataa hataa te
kshamasva nityam trividha aparaadhaan ..8-1..
verses.translation_reworded: O Brahman, in going on pilgrimage to find you, I have denied that you are everywhere. In meditating on you, I have shaped you into a form in my mind, denying that you are formless. In singing hymns, I have described you, denying that you are beyond description. Forgive me these three offenses.

verses.sanskrit:
कामैरहतधीर्दान्तो मृदुः शुचिरकिञ्चनः ।
अनीहो मितभुक् शान्तः स्थिरो मच्छरणो मुनिः ॥ ८-२॥
verses.roman:
kāmairahatadhīrdānto mṛduḥ śucirakiñcanaḥ .
anīho mitabhuk śāntaḥ sthiro maccharaṇo muniḥ ..8-2..
verses.colloquial:
kaamair ahata dhiir daanto mriduh shucir akincanah |
aniiho mita bhuk shaantah sthiro mac charano munih ..8-2..
verses.translation_reworded: A sage is one alone whose intellect desires do not disturb and whose senses are under control; who is gentle, pure, owns nothing, covets nothing, does not crave food, and is serene and steadfast; who has taken refuge in the Self.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्रमत्तो गभीरात्मा धृतिमान् जितषड्गुणः ।
अमानी मानदः कल्पो मैत्रः कारुणिकः कविः ॥ ८-३॥
verses.roman:
apramatto gabhīrātmā dhṛtimān jitaṣaḍguṇaḥ .
amānī mānadaḥ kalpo maitraḥ kāruṇikaḥ kaviḥ ..8-3..
verses.colloquial:
apramatto gabhiiraatmaa dhritimaan jitashadgunah |
amaanii maanadah kalpo maitrah kaarunikah kavih ..8-3..
verses.translation_reworded: The sage stays alert, deep and steady, having mastered the mind and the senses. He is humble and shows respect to everyone. He is courteous, friendly, compassionate and farsighted.

verses.sanskrit:
कृपालुरकृतद्रोहस्तितिक्षुः सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
सत्यसारोऽनवद्यात्मा समः सर्वोपकारकः ॥ ८-४॥
verses.roman:
kṛpālurakṛtadrohastitikṣuḥ sarvadehinām .
satyasāro'navadyātmā samaḥ sarvopakārakaḥ ..8-4..
verses.colloquial:
kripaalur akrita drohas titikshuh sarva dehinaam |
satya saaro anavadya aatmaa samah sarva upakaarakah ..8-4..
verses.translation_reworded: The sage is gracious, harms no one, and bears patiently with all. Firmly grounded in truth and impartial, he does good to everyone. His soul is without blame.

verses.sanskrit:
अवधूतलक्षणं वर्णैर्ज्ञातव्यं भगवत्तमैः ।
वेदवर्णार्थतत्त्वज्ञैर्वेदवेदान्तवादिभिः ॥ ८-५॥
verses.roman:
avadhūtalakṣaṇaṃ varṇairjñātavyaṃ bhagavattamaiḥ .
vedavarṇārthatattvajñairvedavedāntavādibhiḥ ..8-5..
verses.colloquial:
avadhuuta lakshanam varnair jnaatavyam bhagavattamaih |
veda varna artha tattva jnair veda vedaanta vaadibhih ..8-5..
verses.translation_reworded: The marks of a supreme A-VA-DHU-TA should be learned one syllable at a time from teachers of the Vedas and Vedanta who are skilled in understanding the syllables and meaning of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit:
आशापाशविनिर्मुक्त आदिमध्यान्तनिर्मलः ।
आनन्दे वर्तते नित्यमकारं तस्य लक्षणम् ॥ ८-६॥
verses.roman:
āśāpāśavinirmukta ādimadhyāntanirmalaḥ .
ānande vartate nityamakāraṃ tasya lakṣaṇam ..8-6..
verses.colloquial:
aashaa paasha vinirmukta aadi madhya anta nirmalah |
aanande vartate nityam akaaram tasya lakshanam ..8-6..
verses.translation_reworded: In the word Avadhuta, the syllable A shows that he is free from the snare of hopes and expectations. His life remains pure from beginning through middle to end, and he dwells in bliss at all times.

verses.sanskrit:
वासना वर्जिता येन वक्तव्यं च निरामयम् ।
वर्तमानेषु वर्तेत वकारं तस्य लक्षणम् ॥ ८-७॥
verses.roman:
vāsanā varjitā yena vaktavyaṃ ca nirāmayam .
vartamāneṣu varteta vakāraṃ tasya lakṣaṇam ..8-7..
verses.colloquial:
vaasanaa varjitaa yena vaktavyam ca niraamayam .
vartamaaneshu varteta vakaaram tasya lakshanam ..8-7..
verses.translation_reworded: In the word Avadhuta, the syllable VA shows that he has torn out every desire by the roots. His words purify, and he lives at all times in the ever-present Brahman.

verses.sanskrit:
धूलिधूसरगात्राणि धूतचित्तो निरामयः ।
धारणाध्याननिर्मुक्तो धूकारस्तस्य लक्षणम् ॥ ८-८॥
verses.roman:
dhūlidhūsaragātrāṇi dhūtacitto nirāmayaḥ .
dhāraṇādhyānanirmukto dhūkārastasya lakṣaṇam ..8-8..
verses.colloquial:
dhuuli dhuusara gaatraani dhuuta citto niraamayah .
dhaarana dhyaana nirmukto dhuu kaaras tasya lakshanam ..8-8..
verses.translation_reworded: In the word Avadhuta, the syllable DHU shows that although gray dust covers his body because he has no body-consciousness, his mind is pure and healthy. Concentration and meditation are no longer necessary for him.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्वचिन्ता धृता येन चिन्ताचेष्टाविवर्जितः ।
तमोऽहंकारनिर्मुक्तस्तकारस्तस्य लक्षणम् ॥ ८-९॥
verses.roman:
tattvacintā dhṛtā yena cintāceṣṭāvivarjitaḥ .
tamo'haṃkāranirmuktastakārastasya lakṣaṇam ..8-9..
verses.colloquial:
tattva cintaa dhritaa yena cintaa cheshtaa vivarjitah |
tamo ahamkaara nirmuktas takaaras tasya lakshanam ..8-9..
verses.translation_reworded: In the word Avadhuta, the syllable TA shows that he is absorbed in the thought of Brahman, that anxiety does not touch him, and that he feels no need to strive. Egotism and ignorance have left him entirely.

verses.sanskrit:
दत्तात्रेयावधूतेन निर्मितानन्दरूपिणा ।
ये पठन्ति च श‍ृण्वन्ति तेषां नैव पुनर्भवः ॥ ८-१०॥
verses.roman:
dattātreyāvadhūtena nirmitānandarūpiṇā .
ye paṭhanti ca śṛṇvanti teṣāṃ naiva punarbhavaḥ ..8-10..
verses.colloquial:
dattaatreya avadhuutena nirmita aananda ruupinaa .
ye pathanti ca shrinvanti teshaam naiva punar bhavah ..8-10..
verses.translation_reworded: Dattatreya Avadhuta composed this song of bliss. Whoever reads or hears it is released from rebirth.
